abstract: Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) support affordable disease diagnosis. Machine learning (ML) can improve RDT interpretation but often relies on large, proprietary, and costly real-world image libraries. We present SynSight – a ML-enabled RDT segmentation and classification pipeline trained on synthetic data. Validated on HIV (98% sensitivity, 99% specificity) and COVID-19 RDTs (up to 99% accuracy), SynSight enables rapid ML training without real-world training images, keeping pace with new RDT development.

title: LUCQUE: A lung cancer screening dataset from Québec for reliable AI evaluation
zh_title: LUCQUE：魁北克肺癌筛查公开数据集
summary: 发布源自魁北克低剂量 CT 肺癌筛查的大型公开数据集，含临床信息与专家逐体素肺结节、囊肿标注及 Lung-RADS 特征，用于 AI 工具可靠评测。

abstract: BACKGROUND: AI-based tools are expected to play a key role in lung cancer screening (LCS). The evaluation of these tools often relied on private datasets or fragmented public datasets with inconsistent availability of clinical data and expert nodule annotations. This has hindered reproducibility, comparability, and independent assessment of AI tools. To address these gaps, we present LUCQUE, a novel, large, comprehensively annotated dataset derived from LDCT lung cancer screening in Québec, which is accessible for reliable AI evaluation. METHODS: LUCQUE was curated and is hosted on PARADIM, a digital infrastructure supporting DICOM data de-identification, annotation, long-term storage and analysis. LDCT scans and clinical information were combined to a curated collection and complemented by voxel-level, expert-derived pulmonary nodule and cyst segmentations, and Lung-RADS-based lesion characteristics. Key dataset characteristics and statistics were reported, including participant demographics, imaging parameters, radiological findings, and segmented lesion characteristics. Dataset analyses were conducted according to PARADIM's model-to-data approach, in which user code is executed on the platform such that data remains on premise. RESULTS: LUCQUE currently comprises 1,678 LDCT baseline studies from 1,678 participants. Most studies were classified as Lung-RADS 2. A total of 1,776 pulmonary nodules and 60 cysts were annotated, with a median (interquartile range) volume of $89\,(56,\,159)\,\mathrm{mm}^3$ and $1,384\,(589,\,3793)\,\mathrm{mm}^3$ respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Compared to publicly available LCS datasets, LUCQUE currently represents the largest accessible annotated real-world LCS dataset. Access to LUCQUE is provided via a model-to-data approach, enabling privacy-preserving, reproducible, and independent real-world evaluation of AI tools in LCS.
zh_abstract:
【背景】基于AI的工具预期在肺癌筛查（LCS）中发挥关键作用。这些工具的评估往往依赖私有数据集或碎片化的公共数据集，其临床数据和专家结节标注的可获得性不一致。这妨碍了AI工具的可重复性、可比性和独立评估。为弥补这些空白，我们提出LUCQUE，这是一个源自魁北克LDCT肺癌筛查的新型、大型、全面标注数据集，可用于可靠的AI评估。
【方法】LUCQUE已整理并托管在PARADIM上，这是一个支持DICOM数据去标识化、标注、长期存储和分析的数字基础设施。LDCT扫描和临床信息被合并为一个整理后的集合，并由体素级、专家得出的肺结节和囊肿分割以及基于Lung-RADS的病灶特征加以补充。报告了关键数据集特征和统计量，包括参与者人口学特征、成像参数、放射学发现和分割病灶特征。数据集分析按照PARADIM的模型到数据（model-to-data）方法进行，其中用户代码在平台上执行，从而使数据保留在本地。
【结果】LUCQUE目前包含来自1,678名参与者的1,678项LDCT基线检查。大多数检查被分类为Lung-RADS 2。共标注了1,776个肺结节和60个囊肿，其体积中位数（四分位距）分别为89（56，159）mm³和1,384（589，3793）mm³。
【结论】与公开可用的LCS数据集相比，LUCQUE目前是最大的可访问的已标注真实世界LCS数据集。LUCQUE的访问通过模型到数据方法提供，从而能够在LCS中对AI工具进行隐私保护、可重复和独立的真实世界评估。

title: PACE-ECG: Patient-Aware Contrastive ECG Pretraining; Leveraging Longitudinal Structure for Transferable Representations
zh_title: PACE-ECG：患者感知的纵向心电预训练
summary: PACE-ECG 结合同一患者相邻记录的对比学习与临床多任务监督预训练心电表征，在 MIMIC-IV 及两个 HEEDB 外部队列上评估心梗后全因死亡与心衰预测。
key_points: 冻结表征预测心梗后全因死亡与心衰
MIMIC-IV 内域 AUROC 较 DeepECG-SSL 提升 1.9%/4.0%

reason: 预印本但含两个外部队列验证并报告临床预后结局，属重要档
abstract: Foundation models for physiological signals are commonly evaluated on in-domain interpretation tasks, but their ability to transfer to longitudinal clinical prognosis across healthcare systems remains uncertain. We developed PACE-ECG, an ECG pretraining framework that combines contrastive learning across temporally neighbouring recordings from the same patient with clinically guided multitask supervision. We evaluated frozen ECG representations for post-myocardial-infarction all-cause mortality and incident heart failure prediction across MIMIC-IV and two external HEEDB cohorts, comparing the proposed representation with DeepECG-SSL, a state-of-the-art model, and two control baselines. Across both downstream tasks, the proposed model outperformed DeepECG-SSL in-domain (AUROC +1.9% for mortality and +4.0% for heart failure) and on external populations in HEEDB-Boston (+5.6% for mortality +10.3% for heart failure) and HEEDB-Atlanta (+6.9% for mortality +11.0% for heart failure) while using an encoder 41 times smaller and a fraction of the pretraining data. A matched ablation showed that patient-temporal pairing improved external mortality and heart failure AUROC over generic self-supervision by 7.0% and 9.4% on HEEDB-Boston and 8.9% and 9.3% on HEEDB-Atlanta. These findings indicate that pretraining-objective design greatly influences downstream transfer alongside model and data scale, and that in-domain performance alone is insufficient to establish the clinical generalisability of ECG foundation representations.
zh_abstract: 生理信号基础模型通常在同域解释任务上评估，但其跨医疗系统迁移至纵向临床预后的能力仍不确定。我们开发了 PACE-ECG，一种 ECG 预训练框架，它将同一患者时间上相邻记录之间的对比学习与临床引导的多任务监督相结合。我们在 MIMIC-IV 和两个外部 HEEDB 队列中评估冻结的 ECG 表征用于心肌梗死后全因死亡和新发心力衰竭预测，并将所提出的表征与最先进模型 DeepECG-SSL 以及两个对照基线进行比较。在两个下游任务中，所提出的模型在同域内优于 DeepECG-SSL（死亡率 AUROC +1.9%，心力衰竭 +4.0%），并在 HEEDB-Boston 外部人群（死亡率 +5.6%，心力衰竭 +10.3%）和 HEEDB-Atlanta（死亡率 +6.9%，心力衰竭 +11.0%）上优于 DeepECG-SSL，同时使用的编码器小 41 倍，预训练数据仅为其一小部分。一项匹配消融显示，与通用自监督相比，患者-时间配对在 HEEDB-Boston 上将外部死亡率和心力衰竭 AUROC 分别提高 7.0% 和 9.4%，在 HEEDB-Atlanta 上分别提高 8.9% 和 9.3%。这些发现表明，预训练目标设计与模型和数据规模共同极大影响下游迁移，并且仅凭同域性能不足以确立 ECG 基础表征的临床可推广性。

title: Weakly supervised deep learning predicts perineural invasion from H&E whole-slide images in tongue squamous cell carcinoma: development and external validation.

summary: 基于1511张H&E全切片图像开发弱监督模型预测舌鳞癌神经侵犯，并在外部队列验证。

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Perineural invasion (PNI) in tongue squamous cell carcinoma (TSCC) is associated with aggressive behavior and poor outcomes, yet it can be under-recognized on H&E sections because it is often focal and interpretation varies. Manual assessment of PNI suffers from significant interobserver variability, motivating AI-based decision support. We developed and externally validated a weakly supervised WSI model to predict PNI in TSCC. We retrospectively analyzed 1,511 digitized H&E whole-slide images from 629 patients at two centers. Patient-level partitioning yielded an internal training cohort of 305 patients and 787 WSIs, an internal validation cohort of 132 patients and 340 WSIs, and an external test cohort of 192 patients and 384 WSIs. Non-overlapping tiling generated 41,552,500 candidate patches before tissue-background exclusion, of which 7,813,555 unique tissue patches were retained for analysis. A two-stage pipeline was used: patch-level modeling and MIL-based slide aggregation. ResNet50 was selected over Inception_v3 and SimpleViT as the feature extractor. Patch-level prediction probabilities and image features were aggregated into a 101-dimensional patch likelihood histogram (PLH) and a 101-dimensional visual bag-of-words (BoW) representation, respectively. For conventional classifiers, the two representations were concatenated into a 202-dimensional vector, followed by z-score normalization and LASSO feature selection. For the Transformer, the two representations were processed separately using PCA, independently projected into 128-dimensional embedding spaces, and integrated using four-head cross-attention. Performance was assessed by ROC, decision curve analysis (DCA), and calibration. The internal training, internal validation, and external test cohorts included 305, 132, and 192 patients, respectively. PNI prevalence was 82.3%, 79.5%, and 72.9% in these cohorts, respectively. The Transformer fusion model achieved AUCs of 0.990 in the training cohort, 0.968 in the internal validation cohort, and 0.940 in the external test cohort. Calibration and decision curve analysis were used to characterize the model's predicted probabilities and modeled net benefit in the retrospective study cohorts. Patch-level Grad-CAM was used to generate qualitative saliency visualisations associated with ResNet50 patch-level PNI scores. title: Multilevel Integration of Artificial Intelligence and Wearable Biosensors for Precision Health and Clinical Translation.
zh_title: AI 与可穿戴生物传感器的多层次融合综述
summary: 该综述提出 AI 与可穿戴生物传感器三级融合框架，从信号解读到系统级健康判断与器件协同设计。
key_points: 提出初级、次级、三级三层 AI 融合框架
AI 从数据处理工具转向器件与材料协同设计

abstract: [ACS sensors] Wearable biosensors are evolving from passive data loggers toward proactive tools for health monitoring, playing an increasingly important role in personalized and decentralized healthcare. Artificial intelligence (AI) helps address key limitations in this field, including constrained sensing accuracy, complex signal interpretation, and challenges in multimodal data integration. This review summarizes a three-level integration framework, in which AI supports primary-level integration by interpreting acquired signals, secondary-level integration by co-optimizing the sensing process, and tertiary-level integration by producing system-level health judgments. From a technical perspective, AI is progressing from a data-processing tool to a co-design framework that jointly optimizes materials, devices, and signal processing strategies, thereby improving overall performance and stability. In application scenarios, multimodal data fusion and intelligent modeling support decision pipelines that are oriented toward closed-loop operation, enabling more accurate prediction and management of stress, metabolic disorders, neurological diseases, and ophthalmic conditions. These advances are gradually shifting healthcare paradigms from diagnosis-oriented approaches toward earlier and more proactive intervention. Nevertheless, challenges remain in data standardization, model interpretability, and the trade-off between system integration and energy consumption. Future progress is likely to be driven by generative AI, physics-informed modeling, personalized digital twins, and decentralized health systems, collectively pushing wearable biosensors toward higher levels of autonomy and clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [ACS sensors] 可穿戴生物传感器正从被动数据记录器演变为用于健康监测的主动工具，在个性化和去中心化医疗中发挥越来越重要的作用。人工智能（AI）有助于解决该领域的关键局限，包括传感准确性受限、信号解读复杂以及多模态数据整合方面的挑战。本综述总结了一个三级整合框架：AI通过解释所采集信号支持一级整合，通过协同优化传感过程支持二级整合，并通过产生系统级健康判断支持三级整合。从技术角度看，AI正从数据处理工具发展为协同设计框架，联合优化材料、器件和信号处理策略，从而提高整体性能和稳定性。在应用场景中，多模态数据融合和智能建模支持面向闭环运行的决策流程，使对应激、代谢性疾病、神经系统疾病和眼科疾病的预测与管理更加准确。这些进展正逐渐将医疗范式从以诊断为导向的方法转向更早期、更主动的干预。尽管如此，在数据标准化、模型可解释性以及系统集成与能耗之间的权衡方面仍存在挑战。未来进展可能由生成式AI、物理信息建模、个性化数字孪生和去中心化医疗系统推动，共同推动可穿戴生物传感器迈向更高水平的自主性和临床转化。

abstract: [Clinical psychology & psychotherapy] Clinical supervision is fundamental to the development of competent mental health professionals; however, established approaches are limited by challenges in scalability, direct observation and timely feedback. Artificial intelligence has emerged as a potential adjunct to supervision and clinical training, yet the full scope of existing applications has not been systematically mapped. This scoping review systematically mapped artificial intelligence applications in the clinical supervision and training of psychologists and other mental health professionals. The review was conducted in accordance with Joanna Briggs Institute guidance and reported following the PRISMA-ScR. The protocol was registered on the Open Science Framework. Searches were conducted in nine databases, with supplementary searches in Google Scholar. Two reviewers independently screened records; charted data were checked against the original reports. Database searches identified 11,975 records; 4381 duplicates were removed, 7594 records were screened, 817 reports were assessed for eligibility and 73 sources of evidence were included. Four application categories were identified: virtual patient simulation, automated performance assessment, artificial intelligence-enhanced supervisory feedback and training analytics. Most studies were published from 2022 onward and were concentrated in structured therapies, university-based settings and high-income countries. Artificial intelligence is best positioned as an adjunct that expands opportunities for practice, observation and structured feedback, rather than as a replacement for human supervision. Future research should employ more rigorous designs, validated competency measures, transparent reporting of artificial intelligence systems and outcomes relevant to trainees, supervisors and clients.
zh_abstract: [临床心理学与心理治疗] 临床督导是培养胜任的心理健康专业人员的基础；然而，既有方法受到可扩展性、直接观察和及时反馈方面挑战的限制。人工智能已成为督导和临床培训的潜在辅助手段，但现有应用的全部范围尚未被系统性地描绘。本范围综述系统性地描绘了人工智能在心理学家和其他心理健康专业人员的临床督导与培训中的应用。该综述依据 Joanna Briggs Institute 指南开展，并按照 PRISMA-ScR 报告。方案已在 Open Science Framework 上注册。检索在九个数据库中进行，并在 Google Scholar 中进行补充检索。两名评审员独立筛选记录；提取的数据对照原始报告进行了核查。数据库检索识别出11,975条记录；删除4381条重复记录，筛选7594条记录，评估817份报告是否符合纳入标准，最终纳入73个证据来源。识别出四个应用类别：虚拟患者模拟、自动化表现评估、人工智能增强的督导反馈和培训分析。大多数研究发表于2022年及以后，并集中在结构化治疗、大学环境和的高收入国家。人工智能最适合定位为一种辅助手段，扩大实践、观察和结构化反馈的机会，而不是替代人类督导。未来研究应采用更严谨的设计、经过验证的胜任力测量、人工智能系统和结果的透明报告，以及与被督导者、督导者和来访者相关的结果。

abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] Features extracted from sequence homologs significantly enhance the accuracy of deep learning-based protein structure prediction. Indeed, homolog-aware models such as AlphaFold generally produce more accurate protein structures compared to single sequence-based methods like ESMfold. In contrast, features from sequence homologs are seldom employed for deep learning-based prediction of the biological functions of a protein, such as Gene Ontology terms or Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers. Although a small number of models also incorporate function labels from sequence homologs, they cannot utilize features extracted from homologs that lack function labels. To address this gap, we developed EZpred, which is the first deep learning model to use sequence homologs by extracting their sequence features while ignoring any function labels. Starting with the target sequence and homologs identified by MMseqs2, EZpred extracts sequence features using the ESM-C protein language model. These features are then fed into a deep learning model to predict the EC numbers of the target protein. For test enzymes with < 30% sequence identity to any training proteins, the F1-score of EZpred EC number prediction is at least 34% higher than state-of-the-art EC number prediction models. These results demonstrate the strong positive impact of sequence homologs in deep learning-based enzyme function prediction.
zh_abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] 从序列同源物中提取的特征显著提高了基于深度学习的蛋白质结构预测的准确性。事实上，诸如 AlphaFold 之类的同源物感知模型通常比 ESMfold 之类的单序列方法产生更准确的蛋白质结构。相比之下，来自序列同源物的特征很少用于基于深度学习的蛋白质生物学功能预测，例如 Gene Ontology 术语或 Enzyme Commission (EC) 编号。尽管少数模型也整合来自序列同源物的功能标签，但它们无法利用从缺乏功能标签的同源物中提取的特征。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了 EZpred，这是首个通过提取序列同源物的序列特征同时忽略任何功能标签来使用序列同源物的深度学习模型。从目标序列和由 MMseqs2 鉴定的同源物开始，EZpred 使用 ESM-C 蛋白质语言模型提取序列特征。随后这些特征被输入深度学习模型以预测目标蛋白质的 EC 编号。对于与任何训练蛋白序列一致性 < 30% 的测试酶，EZpred 的 EC 编号预测 F1-score 至少比最先进的 EC 编号预测模型高 34%。这些结果证明了序列同源物在基于深度学习的酶功能预测中的强烈正向影响。

title: Adaptive Mask-Guided k-Space Diffusion for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction.
zh_title: 自适应掩码引导的k空间扩散MRI重建
summary: 提出自适应掩码引导扩散模型AMDM，按k空间频率分布构建混合掩码，分离高低频先验以重建欠采样MRI。
key_points: 从k空间自适应估计频率分布构建混合掩码

abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] Masked modeling has emerged as a powerful deep learning paradigm that reconstructs missing data by predicting masked regions, achieving strong performance across multiple domains. As a critical task in medical imaging, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction aims to recover high-quality images from under-sampled k-space data. However, existing methods usually optimize the full image domain or k-space, while overlooking the importance and structural roles of different frequency components. An adaptive mask-guided diffusion model (AMDM) was developed, which leverages adaptively estimated frequency distributions from k-space to construct a hybrid mask mechanism for handling diverse k-space inputs. It enables the effective separation of high-frequency and low-frequency components, producing multiple prior representations. In addition, the frequency distribution is used to generate adaptive masks, which subsequently guide the closed-loop diffusion process. Experimental results demonstrated improved reconstruction performance through frequency-aware modeling. AMDM achieved a PSNR of 36.89 dB on an independent public brain dataset without retraining, even at an under-sampling factor of R = 12 . The proposed method shows that explicitly modeling k-space frequency heterogeneity provides an effective prior for MRI reconstruction, offering a promising direction for robust reconstruction under aggressive under-sampling.
zh_abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] 掩码建模已成为一种强大的深度学习范式，通过预测掩码区域来重建缺失数据，并在多个领域取得强劲性能。作为医学影像中的关键任务，磁共振成像（MRI）重建旨在从欠采样k空间数据中恢复高质量图像。然而，现有方法通常优化整个图像域或k空间，而忽视不同频率成分的重要性和结构作用。开发了一种自适应掩码引导扩散模型（AMDM），其利用从k空间自适应估计的频率分布来构建混合掩码机制，以处理多样化的k空间输入。它能够有效分离高频和低频成分，产生多种先验表示。此外，频率分布用于生成自适应掩码，随后引导闭环扩散过程。实验结果表明，通过频率感知建模提高了重建性能。AMDM在未重新训练的情况下，在独立公共脑数据集上达到了36.89 dB的PSNR，即使在欠采样因子R = 12时也是如此。所提出的方法表明，显式建模k空间频率异质性为MRI重建提供了有效的先验，为在激进欠采样下进行稳健重建提供了有前景的方向。

abstract: [Medical physics] Accurate and comprehensive segmentation of pulmonary vasculature is essential for diagnosing various pulmonary diseases and lung surgical planning. To develop a deep learning model for pulmonary vessels segmentation based on both computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) and non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) data, and to evaluate its performance on a clinical dataset. In this retrospective study, we collected 427 cases of chest CT data from different countries and manufacturers, including 213 CTPA cases and 214 NCCT cases. And we designed a CTPA and NCCT ground truth (GT) generation method producing high-accuracy vessel annotation dataset. Then we developed a 3D U-Net based deep learning method with the Vessel Lumen Structure Optimization Module (VLSOM). We numerically evaluated model using metrics including Centerline Recall (Cl-Recall), Centerline DICE (Cl-DICE), Average Symmetric Surface Distance (ASSD) and 95% Hausdorff Distance (HD95) focusing on the integrity of vascular structures. Finally, the model performance was visually assessed in an independent external dataset. In the numerical evaluation on the internal test dataset with 57 cases, our model achieved Cl-DICE, Cl-Recall and HD95 values of 0.909 (95% CI [0.904, 0.914]), 0.883 (95% CI [0.873, 0.891]) and 1.861 mm (95% CI [1.674 mm, 2.073 mm]) which is superior to the state of the art (SOTA) baseline model nnU-Net v2 of 0.860 (95% CI [0.852, 0.867]), 0.772 (95% CI [0.760, 0.783])and 2.458 mm (95% CI [2.219 mm, 2.708 mm]) (all p < 0.001). In the clinical visual assessments on the 90 sets of external datasets, the average score for accuracy and robustness, branch abundance, computer-aided detection and vascular continuity 4.52 (95% CI [4.42, 4.62]), 4.82 (95% CI [4.76, 4.90]), 4.58 (95% CI [4.46, 4.69]), and 4.85 (95% CI [4.77, 4.92]) respectively with a full score of 5. The proposed pulmonary vessel segmentation algorithm performed well in preserving the connectivity and integrity of the vascular structure on both CTPA and NCCT data with various diseases. A vessel centerline topology-enhanced deep segmentation model enables accurate and automatic pulmonary vessel segmentation in both computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) and non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) images.
zh_abstract: [医学物理] 准确且全面地分割肺血管对于诊断各种肺部疾病和肺手术规划至关重要。开发一种基于计算机断层扫描肺血管造影（CTPA）和非对比计算机断层扫描（NCCT）数据的肺血管分割深度学习模型，并在临床数据集上评估其性能。在这项回顾性研究中，我们收集了来自不同国家和制造商的 427 例胸部 CT 数据，包括 213 例 CTPA 病例和 214 例 NCCT 病例。并且我们设计了一种 CTPA 和 NCCT 真实标签（GT）生成方法，生成高精度血管标注数据集。然后，我们开发了一种基于 3D U-Net 的深度学习方法，并带有血管腔结构优化模块（VLSOM）。我们使用包括中心线召回率（Cl-Recall）、中心线 DICE（Cl-DICE）、平均对称表面距离（ASSD）和 95% Hausdorff 距离（HD95）在内的指标对模型进行数值评估，重点关注血管结构的完整性。最后，在独立外部数据集中对模型性能进行视觉评估。在包含 57 例的内部测试数据集上的数值评估中，我们的模型取得的 Cl-DICE、Cl-Recall 和 HD95 值分别为 0.909（95% CI [0.904, 0.914]）、0.883（95% CI [0.873, 0.891]）和 1.861 mm（95% CI [1.674 mm, 2.073 mm]），优于当前最优（SOTA）基线模型 nnU-Net v2 的 0.860（95% CI [0.852, 0.867]）、0.772（95% CI [0.760, 0.783]）和 2.458 mm（95% CI [2.219 mm, 2.708 mm]）（所有 p < 0.001）。在 90 组外部数据集的临床视觉评估中，准确性及稳健性、分支丰富度、计算机辅助检测和血管连续性的平均得分分别为 4.52（95% CI [4.42, 4.62]）、4.82（95% CI [4.76, 4.90]）、4.58（95% CI [4.46, 4.69]）和 4.85（95% CI [4.77, 4.92]），满分为 5。所提出的肺血管分割算法在保留多种疾病 CTPA 和 NCCT 数据中的血管结构连通性和完整性方面表现良好。一种血管中心线拓扑增强的深度分割模型能够在计算机断层扫描肺血管造影（CTPA）和非对比计算机断层扫描（NCCT）图像中实现准确且自动的肺血管分割。

title: LingoCell interprets gene perturbations through natural language and tissue niches
zh_title: LingoCell：用自然语言与组织微环境解读基因扰动

abstract: Single-cell foundation models are general tools for resolving cell identities and disease states, but struggle to interpret changes in expression magnitude in biological language, to transfer to sparse spatial measurements, and to explain cellular niches. We introduce LingoCell, a foundation model connecting single-cell and spatial transcriptomics. It aligns cell representations with language while keeping gene expression editable, supporting cell annotation, cross-batch integration, description generation, and disease-language readouts of single-gene and combinatorial in silico perturbations. Extended to tissues, it annotates cells without single-cell references, learns identity-conditioned niche embeddings, and performs spatial in silico perturbation by replacing and editing neighbor expression. In lung adenocarcinoma, LingoCell revealed synergistic disease responses to jointly weakening alveolar differentiation programs and strengthening malignant programs. In colorectal cancer, it revealed different programs conveyed by the same fibroblast state to T cells, macrophages, and tumor cells. LingoCell provides a unified framework for prioritizing target combinations and stromal intervention programs.
zh_abstract: 单细胞基础模型是解析细胞身份和疾病状态的通用工具，但难以用生物学语言解释表达量幅度的变化、迁移到稀疏空间测量，以及解释细胞生态位。我们介绍LingoCell，一种连接单细胞和空间转录组学的基础模型。它将细胞表示与语言对齐，同时保持基因表达可编辑，支持细胞注释、跨批次整合、描述生成，以及单基因和组合计算机模拟扰动的疾病语言读出。扩展到组织后，它无需单细胞参考即可注释细胞，学习身份条件化的生态位嵌入，并通过替换和编辑邻近细胞表达进行空间计算机模拟扰动。在肺腺癌中，LingoCell揭示了共同削弱肺泡分化程序和增强恶性程序所产生的协同疾病反应。在结直肠癌中，它揭示了同一成纤维细胞状态向T细胞、巨噬细胞和肿瘤细胞传递的不同程序。LingoCell提供了一个统一框架，用于优先排序靶点组合和基质干预程序。

abstract: Accurate cancer survival prediction remains challenging due to tumor heterogeneity. Although multimodal survival models integrate clinical and molecular data, they often overlook evolutionary information encoded in genomic alterations. To address this gap, we developed eTime, a 38-dimensional evolutionary representation comprising eight feature groups that characterize clonal and subclonal mutation burden, mutational spectra, functional consequences, copy-number alterations, and anoikis-related genomic changes. We further developed EvoSurv, a multimodal survival framework integrating eTime with clinical variables and RNA expression. Across six TCGA cancer cohorts comprising 2,782 patients, EvoSurv achieved the highest mean concordance index (C-index) in all six cancers, averaging 0.663 and outperforming three state-of-the-art survival prediction methods. More importantly, we assessed whether evolutionary features provide additional prognostic information beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors. eTime remained significantly associated with survival in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSC) and liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) after adjustment for clinical variables and RNA-derived risk scores. Feature-group analyses further revealed cancer-specific prognostic patterns. In HNSC, T>G substitutions were associated with increased mortality risk after clinical and molecular adjustment, including in HPV-negative patients, with supporting evidence from an independent CPTAC-HNSCC cohort. Overall, these findings demonstrate that eTime captures survival-associated evolutionary information and highlight its potential to provide prognostic value beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors.
zh_abstract: 由于肿瘤异质性，准确的癌症生存预测仍具有挑战性。尽管多模态生存模型整合了临床和分子数据，但它们常常忽视基因组改变中编码的进化信息。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了eTime，这是一种38维进化表征，包含八个特征组，用于刻画克隆和亚克隆突变负荷、突变谱、功能后果、拷贝数改变以及失巢凋亡相关基因组改变。我们进一步开发了EvoSurv，这是一个将eTime与临床变量和RNA表达整合的多模态生存框架。在包含2,782例患者的六个TCGA癌症队列中，EvoSurv在所有六种癌症中均取得最高平均一致性指数（C-index），平均为0.663，并优于三种当前最佳的生存预测方法。更重要的是，我们评估了进化特征是否提供超越临床和转录组预测因素的额外预后信息。在调整临床变量和基于RNA的风险评分后，eTime在头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSC）和肝细胞癌（LIHC）中仍与生存显著相关。特征组分析进一步揭示了癌症特异性预后模式。在HNSC中，经临床和分子调整后，T>G替换与死亡风险增加相关，包括在HPV阴性患者中，并有来自独立CPTAC-HNSCC队列的支持性证据。总体而言，这些发现表明eTime捕获了与生存相关的进化信息，并突出其提供超越临床和转录组预测因素的预后价值的潜力。

title: Automated Continuous LLM-driven Biomedical Literature Mining for a Large-Scale Hepatotoxicity Knowledge Base
zh_title: LLM 自动挖掘文献构建肝毒性知识库
summary: 预印本描述用大模型自动从文献抽取肝毒性发现并写入结构化知识库，当前收录约 18.9 万条记录。
key_points: 覆盖 5.3 万篇文献、1.7 万种化合物的 18.9 万条发现
按固定字段与控制词表抽取并去重持续更新
基于 35 篇文献中 217 条记录进行人工核查
reason: 大规模自动化抽取流程与可更新知识库有新意，但尚为预印本且人工核查规模有限
abstract: Predicting whether a chemical disturbs liver and mitochondrial function matters for drug safety and environmental risk assessment, but the data available for training such models are small and mostly curated by hand. We describe an automated pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) to collect hepatotoxicity findings from the biomedical literature. The pipeline runs a PubMed/PMC query, downloads the matching full texts or abstracts, asks the LLM to record each reported effect in a fixed schema (tested chemical, biomarker, direction of change, and related fields) with controlled vocabularies, and writes de-duplicated records to a database that is updated as new papers appear. The current snapshot holds 189,212 findings on 17,002 chemicals from 53,575 articles (1995-2026), covering 235 biomarkers reported for at least 20 chemicals. In a manual check of 217 findings from 35 articles, 208 findings (from 33 articles) were fully correct; the other 9, all from 2 articles, were incorrect. As a use case, we train structure-based QSAR models, both graph neural networks and classic baselines, for each biomarker; at this data scale the classic models remain competitive. The pipeline and the knowledge base will be made publicly available.
zh_abstract: 预测一种化学物质是否干扰肝脏和线粒体功能，对于药物安全性和环境风险评估至关重要，但可用于训练此类模型的数据量很小，且大多由人工整理。我们描述了一个自动化流程，该流程使用大型语言模型（LLM）从生物医学文献中收集肝毒性发现。该流程运行 PubMed/PMC 查询，下载匹配的全文或摘要，要求 LLM 以固定模式（受试化学物质、生物标志物、变化方向及相关字段）并使用受控词表记录每项报告效应，并将去重后的记录写入一个随新论文出现而更新的数据库。当前快照包含来自 53,575 篇文章（1995-2026）的 17,002 种化学物质的 189,212 条发现，涵盖至少报告于 20 种化学物质的 235 个生物标志物。在对来自 35 篇文章的 217 条发现进行人工核查时，208 条发现（来自 33 篇文章）完全正确；其余 9 条均来自 2 篇文章，不正确。作为一个用例，我们为每个生物标志物训练基于结构的 QSAR 模型，包括图神经网络和经典基线；在此数据规模下，经典模型仍具竞争力。该流程和知识库将公开提供。

title: ASD Neuro Agentic (ANA): An Agentic Framework for Feature Discovery and Cross Site Generalization in Autism fMRI Classification
zh_title: 智能体框架ANA提升自闭症fMRI跨站点泛化
summary: 预印本用语言模型智能体提出特征、固定工具计算，在17个ABIDE中心筛选站点无关的自闭症fMRI分类器。
key_points: 17个ABIDE中心共1028名参与者
测试71条流程，选出ComBat调和集成模型
留一中心验证AUC 0.814，优于两个对照模型
reason: 预印本但有17中心留一站点验证并与基线对比，重要档下调
abstract: Classifiers of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) from resting state functional MRI rarely generalize across sites, and many reported accuracies are inflated by data leakage.We show that an agentic artificial intelligence framework, ASD Neuro Agentic (ANA), whose language model agents propose features from the literature and researcher input while fixed tools perform every calculation, can search auditably for site independent classifiers while controlling the leakage. In 1,028 participants from 17 ABIDE I centers, ANA tested 71 pipelines and selected a ComBat harmonized ensemble of tangent space connectivity models from six parcellations and 98 public connectivity derivatives. In leave one center out testing, the ensemble reached an area under the curve of 0.814 (95% CI, 0.773 to 0.841), outperforming ASD DiagNet and ASD SAENet. Predictive connectivity was mainly reduced in ASD. Agentic AI offers a systematic and efficient approach to exploring, evaluating, and identifying pipelines as model selection grows complex.
zh_abstract: 从静息态功能MRI中构建自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类器很少能跨站点泛化，而且许多报告的准确率因数据泄漏而被夸大。我们展示了一种代理式人工智能框架ASD Neuro Agentic（ANA），其语言模型代理从文献和研究输入中提出特征，而固定工具执行所有计算，从而能够在控制泄漏的同时以可审计的方式搜索站点独立分类器。在来自17个ABIDE I中心的1,028名参与者中，ANA测试了71条流程，并选择了由六个分区和98个公共连接衍生特征构成的切线空间连接模型的ComBat协调集成。在留一中心交叉测试中，该集成达到曲线下面积0.814（95% CI，0.773至0.841），优于ASD DiagNet和ASD SAENet。预测性连接在ASD中主要表现为降低。代理式AI提供了一种系统且高效的方法来探索、评估和识别流程，随着模型选择变得复杂。

title: AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma
zh_title: AI刻画肺鳞癌淋巴结构与肿瘤微环境
summary: 用深度学习在H&E全片量化三级淋巴结构、淋巴结滤泡与浆细胞，比较新辅助治疗前后肺鳞癌差异并在独立队列验证预后价值。
key_points: 新辅助治疗与未治疗各20例配对原发灶与淋巴结
深度学习模型经病理医生标注验证并分级成熟度
独立队列458例（46例接受治疗）检验预后价值
reason: 含独立队列验证但主分析样本小、属预印本，值得一看档
abstract: Mature, germinal centre-bearing tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and mature lymph node follicles (secondary lymphoid structures, SLS) sustain the plasma cell response that shapes outcome and immunotherapy benefit in lung cancer. How this loco-regional axis differs between neoadjuvant-treated and therapy-naive tumors is poorly defined. We analyzed H&E whole-slide images of resected tumors and paired proximal and distal lymph nodes from matched neoadjuvant-treated (neoLUSC, n=20) and therapy-naive (naivLUSC, n=20) lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patients. Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis (HETA) models quantified cell densities per tissue compartment and cell-cell co-localization; a dedicated deep-learning model validated against pathologist annotations detected TLS and SLS and graded their maturity. Prognostic value was tested in an independent cohort (n=458; 46 treated). In neoLUSC tumors, stromal plasma cell density was 72% (p=0.004) and stromal lymphocyte density 48% (p=0.015) lower than in naivLUSC; macrophages and granulocytes did not differ significantly. Total and immature TLS did not differ, whereas mature TLS in the tumor (p=0.034) and mature SLS in the tumor-distal lymph node (p=0.003) were lower in neoLUSC patients. Peri-TLS plasma cell density correlated with tumor lymphocyte density in naivLUSC (rho=0.54, p=0.017) but not in neoLUSC tumors (rho=0.07). In the validation cohort, stromal plasma cell density (HR 0.69, p=0.011) and lymphocyte-plasma cell co-localization (HR 0.66, p=0.004) were associated with longer survival, and neoadjuvant status with shorter survival (HR 1.50, p=0.026). Neoadjuvant therapy is thus associated with fewer mature lymphoid structures and weaker coupling of the humoral compartment to the tumor rather than uniformly lower immune readouts. The stromal plasma cell/co-localization axis is a candidate prognostic biomarker.
zh_abstract: 成熟的、含生发中心的三级淋巴结构（TLS）和成熟淋巴结滤泡（次级淋巴结构，SLS）维持浆细胞反应，而该反应塑造肺癌的结局和免疫治疗获益。这一局部-区域轴在新辅助治疗肿瘤与未治疗肿瘤之间的差异尚不明确。我们分析了匹配的新辅助治疗（neoLUSC，n=20）和未治疗（naivLUSC，n=20）肺鳞状细胞癌（LUSC）患者切除肿瘤及配对的近端和远端淋巴结的H&E全切片图像。Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis（HETA）模型量化了每个组织隔室的细胞密度和细胞-细胞共定位；一个经病理学家注释验证的专用深度学习模型检测TLS和SLS并对其成熟度进行分级。在独立队列（n=458；46例接受治疗）中检验了预后价值。在neoLUSC肿瘤中，间质浆细胞密度比naivLUSC低72%（p=0.004），间质淋巴细胞密度低48%（p=0.015）；巨噬细胞和粒细胞无显著差异。总TLS和未成熟TLS无差异，而neoLUSC患者肿瘤中的成熟TLS（p=0.034）和肿瘤远端淋巴结中的成熟SLS（p=0.003）较低。在naivLUSC中，TLS周围浆细胞密度与肿瘤淋巴细胞密度相关（rho=0.54，p=0.017），但在neoLUSC肿瘤中不相关（rho=0.07）。在验证队列中，间质浆细胞密度（HR 0.69，p=0.011）和淋巴细胞-浆细胞共定位（HR 0.66，p=0.004）与更长的生存期相关，而新辅助治疗状态与更短的生存期相关（HR 1.50，p=0.026）。因此，新辅助治疗与较少的成熟淋巴结构和体液隔室与肿瘤之间较弱的耦合相关，而不是免疫读数普遍降低。间质浆细胞/共定位轴是一个候选预后生物标志物。

title: Curbside Chatbots: Auditing the Mental Health Interventions Large Language Models Recommend to Clinicians, Caregivers, and Patients
zh_title: 审计大模型向医生、照护者与患者推荐的心理健康方案
summary: 用19个案例、5个问题测试41个大模型，收集35055条回答，审计其在医生、照护者与本人三种视角下的心理健康干预推荐差异。
key_points: 同一临床信息以三种身份视角输入模型
用验证过的判定工具抽取全部干预名称
模型常把自身评分偏低的选项作为首选推荐
reason: 评测规模大、设计有新意但为预印本且无临床结局，值得一看档
abstract: Users are asking language models mental health questions and are receiving answers. We audited what 41 language models recommend to users when the same clinical information reaches them from three footings: a clinician describing a patient, a caregiver describing a loved one, or a person describing themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and five questions, we collected 35,055 free-text responses, extracted every intervention named with a validated judge, and had 29 models rate the full option lists on a seven-point Likert scale for the same cases. Models largely recommend what they rate well, with recommendation behavior differing by footing, and many models offering clinicians a consultation-style response and lay users hedged, simplified advice. When asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, usually with conditions attached. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus on publication as a living audit.
zh_abstract: 用户正在向语言模型提出心理健康问题，并正在收到回答。我们审计了当同一临床信息以三种立足点到达模型时，41 个语言模型向用户推荐什么：临床医生描述患者、照护者描述亲人，或本人描述自己。在 19 个案例小故事和五个问题中，我们收集了 35,055 条自由文本回答，使用经验证的判定器提取每一个被命名的干预措施，并让 29 个模型对相同案例的完整选项列表进行七点李克特量表评分。模型大体上推荐它们评分较高的内容，推荐行为因立足点而异，许多模型向临床医生提供会诊式回答，而向非专业用户提供含糊的、简化的建议。当被询问针对特定干预类型的推荐时，模型更常将自身评分低于零的选项列为初始选择，通常附带条件。我们将在发表时作为持续审计发布工具、代码和完整语料库。

title: A local language model layered with rule-based and neural detectors for clinical text de-identification: an open-source toolkit and evaluation
zh_title: 本地语言模型叠加规则与神经检测器的临床文本去标识工具
summary: 开源工具DeidSharp以本地26B大模型叠加模式与临床NER检测器做PHI去标识，并在护理记录与MIMIC-IV-Note上对比多种工具。
key_points: 多检测器融合且任一检测器报错即失败关闭
在889条护理记录标注与29023条合成出院小结上评测
与deid、Philter等五个工具做配对bootstrap比较
reason: 公开工具+多工具对比与预设方案，但为预印本且仅公开数据集
abstract: Objectives: To measure whether a locally hosted large language model (LLM), stacked with deterministic and clinical named-entity recognition (NER) detectors, finds more protected health information (PHI) than open tools, and at what precision. Materials and Methods: DeidSharp, an open-source .NET toolkit, combines the findings of pluggable detectors (patterns, a clinical NER model, a local 26B mixture-of-experts LLM) and fails closed on any detector error. Configurations fixed on tuning halves were compared, under a prespecified protocol, with deid, Philter, the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, OpenAI Privacy Filter and GLiNER on reporting halves of PhysioNet's nursing notes (889 spans) and semi-synthetic MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries (29,023 spans), and on synthetic ASQ-PHI queries, with paired patient-level bootstrap intervals. Results: In the nursing notes, against Stanford/Penn, the recall-first stack found 98.9% of PHI (+2.8, 95% CI 1.4 to 4.4) at 9.3 points lower precision; the precision-first stack, without NER, found 96.5%, matching Stanford/Penn, at 19.6 points higher precision (83.2%). In the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points (recall-first 95.3%, +21.5, 20.5 to 22.4), almost entirely on generated untyped names; on typed labels all three exceeded 99%. All four prespecified comparisons held. No configuration beat deid significantly on its home corpus; Philter found more discharge-summary spans than the recall-first stack at 23 points lower precision. Discussion: The LLM was the main detector and NER added place names; asked to verify its own findings, the LLM discarded a quarter of true PHI. Conclusion: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors offers recall-first and precision-first operating points without sending text off-site.
zh_abstract: 【目的】评估本地托管的大语言模型（LLM）与确定性检测器和临床命名实体识别（NER）检测器叠加后，是否比开放工具发现更多受保护健康信息（PHI），以及其精确度如何。【材料与方法】DeidSharp 是一个开源 .NET 工具包，它结合可插拔检测器（模式规则、临床 NER 模型、本地 26B 混合专家 LLM）的发现，并在任何检测器出错时采用故障关闭（fail closed）策略。在预设方案下，将调参半集上固定的配置与 deid、Philter、Stanford/Penn 去标识器、OpenAI Privacy Filter 和 GLiNER 在 PhysioNet 护理记录（889 个跨度）和半合成 MIMIC-IV-Note 出院小结（29,023 个跨度）的报告半集上进行比较，并在合成 ASQ-PHI 查询上比较，采用配对的患者水平 bootstrap 区间。【结果】在护理记录中，与 Stanford/Penn 相比，召回优先的叠加方案发现 98.9% 的 PHI（+2.8，95% CI 1.4 至 4.4），精确度低 9.3 个百分点；精确度优先的叠加方案（不含 NER）发现 96.5%，与 Stanford/Penn 相当，精确度高 19.6 个百分点（83.2%）。在出院小结中，两种叠加方案均领先 Stanford/Penn 超过 20 个百分点（召回优先 95.3%，+21.5，20.5 至 22.4），几乎完全归因于生成的未分型姓名；在分型标签上，三者均超过 99%。所有四项预设比较均成立。没有任何配置在其本家语料上显著优于 deid；Philter 在出院小结中发现的跨度多于召回优先叠加方案，但精确度低 23 个百分点。【讨论】LLM 是主要检测器，NER 增加了地名；当要求 LLM 核验自身发现时，它丢弃了四分之一真实 PHI。【结论】将本地 LLM 与确定性检测器分层组合，可提供召回优先和精确度优先的工作点，而无需将文本发送到异地。

title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
zh_title: TrialDesignBench：I期试验设计的语言模型基准
summary: 发布617项肿瘤I/I-II期剂量探索试验基准，配专家校验、符合FDA最新监管要求的参考设计。
key_points: 617项肿瘤I/I-II期剂量探索试验
参考设计经专家校验并对齐FDA Optumus
为AI辅助试验设计提供评测基础
reason: 新发布中等规模专家标注基准，公开可评测，但为预印本且无模型效果数据
abstract: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.
zh_abstract: AI 被用于临床试验流程的许多环节。然而，选择试验的统计设计——这一决定药物剂量如何在人体中测试和评估的关键步骤——几乎未取得 AI 进展。鉴于 LLMs 在生物医学知识和统计推理方面的优势，它们似乎是自然的选择。然而，目前没有适当的方法来评估这些能力，因为近期的监管和方法学转变，尤其是 FDA 的 Project Optimus，重新定义了何为合理设计，并使许多先前设计过时。为 AI 辅助试验设计奠定基础，我们推出 TrialDesignBench，这是一个包含 617 项 I/I-II 期肿瘤剂量探索试验的基准，每项试验均配有一个经专家验证、符合最新 FDA 监管倡议的参考设计。该参考标准通过对专家设计过程的形式化而产生。我们评估了五个前沿 LLM，没有一个与参考标准匹配。我们的消融实验将这一性能差距追溯到两个主要原因：从试验来源推断潜在的、未记录的设计决定因素（提供这些因素可将类别平衡准确率提高 0.22）以及结构化决策树推理（+0.24）。TrialDesignBench 为评估和增强 AI 辅助试验设计提供了一个可重复、符合当代标准的客观标准。

title: BioMem: Agentic Memory for Biomedical LLM Agents
zh_title: BioMem：生物医学LLM智能体的记忆机制评估
summary: 系统评估5种记忆方案在4个LLM、3类生物医学任务中的有效性、检索质量与长期稳健性。
key_points: 覆盖知识推理、临床预测与长期对话记忆三类场景
比较5种智能体记忆方法与4个LLM的组合表现
分析记忆构建、证据相关性与对话历史对下游表现的影响
reason: 系统化多模型多任务评测有新意，但为预印本且未说明公开数据或权重，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions. However, a fundamental question remains: how effectively and reliably do these systems retain, retrieve, update, and utilize biomedical information? In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness. We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory. Our analyses reveal how memory construction, evidence relevance, and conversational history shape downstream biomedical performance, highlighting the distinct challenges of retrieving relevant information, preserving its fidelity, and effectively utilizing it for reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization (HMRU), a training-free framework that jointly enhances evidence accessibility and task-aware utilization to improve biomedical reasoning and long-term conversational memory. HMRU achieves an average relative improvement of 8.6% across biomedical question-answering and conversational memory benchmarks, with additional gains in selected clinical prediction tasks. It further reduces conversational answer errors by 24.9% and closes 48.0% of the performance gap to full-context inference. Our findings provide a systematic characterization of biomedical agentic memory and practical insights into developing more effective and reliable memory-augmented LLM systems.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已在生物医学应用中展现出相当大的潜力，而智能体记忆系统已成为一种有前景的方法，用于跨任务和交互保存与利用信息。然而，一个基本问题仍然存在：这些系统在多大程度上能够有效且可靠地保留、检索、更新和利用生物医学信息？本研究系统考察生物医学领域的智能体记忆，聚焦任务有效性、检索质量、信息保真度和长期稳健性。我们在三种代表性设置——生物医学知识推理、临床预测和长期对话记忆——中，针对四个LLM评估五种记忆方法。我们的分析揭示了记忆构建、证据相关性和对话历史如何塑造下游生物医学性能，突出展示了检索相关信息、保持其保真度以及有效利用其进行推理方面的不同挑战。基于这些发现，我们提出混合记忆检索与利用（HMRU），这是一个无需训练的框架，联合增强证据可访问性和任务感知利用，以改善生物医学推理和长期对话记忆。HMRU在生物医学问答和对话记忆基准上实现平均8.6%的相对提升，并在选定的临床预测任务中带来额外增益。它还将对话答案错误减少24.9%，并缩小了与全上下文推理之间性能差距的48.0%。我们的发现提供了对生物医学智能体记忆的系统性刻画，并为开发更有效、更可靠的记忆增强LLM系统提供了实践见解。

title: Predicting cell-state-specific gene regulation from DNA across species.
source: PubMed · bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
zh_title: Bolero：跨物种预测细胞状态特异基因调控
summary: 以细胞状态嵌入为条件的序列到功能模型，从DNA预测细胞状态特异的染色质可及性与转录丰度。
key_points: 训练数据含6种哺乳动物33个数据集共1070万细胞
性能匹配或超过专用模型，可区分近缘细胞状态调控差异
可解析皮层区域与发育梯度的调控差异
reason: 千万级细胞、跨物种多数据集大规模训练并优于专用模型，满足大规模公开数据/方法信号，属重要档
abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] DNA encodes the cell's phenotype, but the same DNA sequence is interpreted differently in every cell type, developmental stage, and activity state. Existing deep-learning models solve only half of this puzzle: sequence-to-function models read DNA but treat cell state as a fixed label, while single-cell foundation models represent cell state but not sequence. We developed Bolero, a sequence-to-function model whose parameters condition on atlas-scale cell-state embeddings and additional biological variables to predict cell-state-specific chromatin accessibility and transcript abundance from DNA. Trained on 10.7 million cells from 33 datasets across six mammals, Bolero matched or exceeded specialised models and resolved regulatory differences between closely related cell states, including cortical regional and developmental gradients. Extrapolating cell-state embeddings extended Bolero's predictions to cell states that are absent from training. Cell-state conditioning facilitated tracing of the effects of non-coding variants to the cell types in which they act. Using an AP-1 activity score as a further continuous conditioning axis, Bolero predicted activity-regulated chromatin changes without requiring actual stimulation data. Across human cell types, we reconstructed the cooperative grammar of motif identity and spacing underlying predicted AP-1 responses. Bolero further predicted cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility and AP-1 responses in species excluded from training, extending comparative genomics from sequence conservation to predicted functional conservation. Across 84 mammals, we found that predicted AP-1 responses were less conserved than chromatin accessibility at cis-regulatory elements, driven by the human-specific sequence variants on AP-1 and cooperating motifs. By combining reference genomes with reference cell atlases, Bolero allowed genome sequences, either native or mutated, to be queried across cell states, perturbations, and different species for their chromatin and expression signatures.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] DNA编码细胞表型，但同一DNA序列在每个细胞类型、发育阶段和活动状态中的解释不同。现有深度学习模型只解决了这一问题的一半：序列到功能模型读取DNA，但将细胞状态视为固定标签，而单细胞基础模型表示细胞状态但不表示序列。我们开发了Bolero，这是一种序列到功能模型，其参数以图谱规模细胞状态嵌入和额外生物变量为条件，从DNA预测细胞状态特异性染色质可及性和转录本丰度。Bolero在来自六个哺乳动物33个数据集的1070万个细胞上训练，匹配或超过了专门模型，并解析了密切相关的细胞状态之间的调控差异，包括皮层区域和发育梯度。外推细胞状态嵌入将Bolero的预测扩展到训练中不存在的细胞状态。细胞状态条件化促进了将非编码变异的影响追踪到其发挥作用的细胞类型。使用AP-1活性评分作为进一步的连续条件化轴，Bolero在不需要实际刺激数据的情况下预测了活动调控的染色质变化。在各类人类细胞类型中，我们重建了预测AP-1反应所基于的基序身份和间距的协同语法。Bolero进一步预测了未纳入训练物种中的细胞类型特异性染色质可及性和AP-1反应，将比较基因组学从序列保守性扩展到预测的功能保守性。在84个哺乳动物中，我们发现预测的AP-1反应在顺式调控元件处比染色质可及性更不保守，这由AP-1及协作基序上的人类特异性序列变异驱动。通过将参考基因组与参考细胞图谱相结合，Bolero使得无论是天然还是突变的基因组序列都能够在不同细胞状态、扰动和不同物种中查询其染色质和表达特征。

title: Safeguarding Agentic AI in Radiology Workflows: A Multimodel Evaluation of Rule-based and Large Language Model-based Verification
zh_title: 放射流程智能体AI安全护栏多模型评估
summary: 仿真研究用91个场景、1638次会话评估6个工具调用型LLM智能体的高危错误及规则与LLM校验的削减效果。
key_points: 48个经放射科医师审阅的合成基础场景
对比仅权限、确定性规则、规则加本地LLM校验
主要结局为每会话至少一次高严重度违规
reason: 多模型大规模仿真评测设计较完整，但为预印本模拟研究，属值得一看档
abstract: Purpose: To estimate how often tool-using large language model (LLM) agents record clinically relevant false or unsupported information in simulated radiology documentation and how much safeguards applied before each action reduce these errors. Materials and Methods: In this simulation study (October 2026), 48 synthetic, radiologist-reviewed base scenarios covered finding communication, tumor board preparation and follow-up management. Forty-three also had a misleading-information variant (91 variants). Six LLM agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B) completed each variant with permissions only, deterministic rules, and rules plus a locally run LLM checker (1638 episodes). The primary outcome was at least one executed high-severity violation per episode. Risk differences were estimated per agent at base-scenario level and, exploratorily, pooled across agents, with analyses of document access and blocks. Results: With permissions only, 7.3%-27.1% of episodes had a high-severity violation (pooled across agents, 19.4%). Pooled, it was 16.7% with rules (-2.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -6.1, 0.5) and 13.2% with rules plus the LLM checker (-6.2; 95% CI: -9.5, -3.0). Adding the LLM checker to rules changed it by -3.5 (95% CI: -6.3, -0.7). No difference between agents was detected (P = .43), and task success did not decrease detectably. In misleading variants, agents opened the altered document in 83% of episodes regardless of error, and 58% of erroneous statements cited it. Most blocked actions (64%-68%) would not have caused a violation and were returned for revision. Conclusion: Layered safeguards reduced but did not prevent high-severity errors. Errors after misleading information reflected misjudged rather than missed information.
zh_abstract: 【目的】估计在模拟放射学文档中，使用工具的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体记录临床相关的虚假或无支持信息的频率，以及每次行动前应用的安全防护措施能在多大程度上减少这些错误。【材料与方法】在这项模拟研究（2026年10月）中，48个经放射科医生审核的合成基础场景涵盖了检查结果沟通、肿瘤委员会准备和随访管理。其中43个还设有一个误导信息变体（共91个变体）。六个LLM智能体（Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1-Sol、GLM-5.3、MiniMax M3、Gemma-4-31B、Qwen3.8-27B）分别在仅授予权限、确定性规则、以及规则加本地运行的LLM检查器的条件下完成每个变体（共1638个回合）。主要结局是每个回合中至少发生一次已执行的高严重度违规。风险差异按智能体在基础场景层面估计，并探索性地跨智能体合并，同时分析文档访问和阻断情况。【结果】在仅授予权限时，7.3%-27.1%的回合存在高严重度违规（跨智能体合并为19.4%）。合并后，使用规则时为16.7%（-2.8个百分点；95% CI：-6.1，0.5），使用规则加LLM检查器时为13.2%（-6.2；95% CI：-9.5，-3.0）。在规则基础上加入LLM检查器使其变化-3.5（95% CI：-6.3，-0.7）。未检测到智能体之间的差异（P = .43），且任务成功率未见可检测的下降。在误导性变体中，无论是否出错，智能体在83%的回合中打开了被篡改的文档，58%的错误陈述引用了该文档。大多数被阻断的行动（64%-68%）本不会导致违规，并被退回修改。【结论】分层防护措施减少了但并未防止高严重度错误。误导信息之后的错误反映的是信息判断错误，而非信息遗漏。

title: Answer or Defer? Testing VLMs' Stated Confidence on Brain MRI
zh_title: 视觉语言模型在脑MRI上按置信度弃答的可行性
summary: 预印本用8个开源视觉语言模型评测3888张脑MRI切片，发现置信度阈值无法在5%错误率内保留有效覆盖。
key_points: 8个开源视觉语言模型，含2个推理模型
BraTS 2024与IXI共3888张脑MRI切片
任何阈值均未达5%经验错误率下非空覆盖
reason: 规模可观的多模型评测预印本，结论为负向但证据有限
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) could support medical-image interpretation, but their use requires deciding which interpretations to accept and which images to refer to a clinician. We test whether thresholding stated confidence can retain useful coverage while limiting errors among accepted answers, and how this depends on the population. Eight open-weight VLMs, including two reasoning models, assess 3,888 brain MRI slices from post-treatment glioma patients (BraTS 2024) and healthy volunteers (IXI) for tumor or gross abnormality. BraTS labels are mask-derived; IXI slices are treated as negatives. On BraTS, no threshold selects a nonempty set with at most 5% empirical error for any model, even when chosen retrospectively. This also holds for four models evaluated on a large-lesion, distant-negative subset. At a 10% error budget, Gemma-4-12B retains 24.4% of slices and every other model at most 2.5%. To investigate this limited selection ability, we separate confidence differences between predicted answers from differences within each answer. For four models with available outcome-level summaries, pooled mean confidence differs more between answers than between correct and incorrect responses within each answer. A covariance decomposition explains how this pattern can produce opposite confidence-correctness associations across populations. At a 20% error budget, accepting every "tumor" answer covers more slices than any confidence threshold for two models. These findings caution against using unvalidated stated confidence as a standalone deferral signal and support population-specific validation before deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/amir-sbg/VLM-Answer-or-Defer.
zh_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）可以支持医学图像解读，但其使用需要决定接受哪些解读以及将哪些图像转诊给临床医生。我们检验对模型自述置信度进行阈值化是否能在保留有用覆盖范围的同时限制被接受答案中的错误，以及这如何取决于人群。八个开放权重VLM（包括两个推理模型）评估了来自治疗后胶质瘤患者（BraTS 2024）和健康志愿者（IXI）的3,888张脑MRI切片，以判断肿瘤或大体异常。BraTS标签由掩膜导出；IXI切片被视为阴性。在BraTS上，对于任何模型，即使回顾性选择阈值，也没有任何阈值能选出一个非空集合且经验错误率至多为5%。这同样适用于在一个大病灶、远距离阴性子集上评估的四个模型。在10%错误预算下，Gemma-4-12B保留了24.4%的切片，而其他每个模型至多保留2.5%。为研究这种有限的选择能力，我们将预测答案之间的置信度差异与每个答案内部的差异分开。对于四个具有可用结果层面汇总的模型，合并平均置信度在答案之间的差异大于在每个答案内部正确与错误响应之间的差异。协方差分解解释了这种模式如何在跨人群时产生相反的置信度-正确性关联。在20%错误预算下，对两个模型而言，接受每一个“肿瘤”答案比任何置信度阈值覆盖更多切片。这些发现警示不要将未经校验的自述置信度用作独立的转诊信号，并支持在部署前进行人群特异性验证。代码见 https://github.com/amir-sbg/VLM-Answer-or-Defer。

title: The Average Patient: Do Simulated Psychiatric Patients Answer Like Real People?
zh_title: 模拟精神科患者是否像真人一样作答
summary: 预印本对比17个语言模型模拟患者与八个人类样本的条目级作答，发现模拟变异远低于真人且症状普遍居中。
key_points: 提出信息预算与平均患者假设框架
17个模型对比8个人类样本含临床与伪装样本
同总分下模拟变异比真人低1.5至11倍
reason: 有人类样本对照的多模型评估预印本，方法有新意但未经同行评审
abstract: Language models are used as simulated psychiatric patients to train clinicians and evaluate AI therapists, and are judged by plausibility or total scores. We give a framework for simulated respondents: an information budget bounds how much simulated patients can differ, and an average-patient hypothesis, that a model answers each item at the level typical of the named condition and severity, implies little variation, a full profile of the condition's typical symptoms and totals at or above the top of the stated severity band. We examine these implications at matched totals on item-level data from eight human samples, including a clinical and an instructed-feigning sample. Across 17 models, simulated patients vary 1.5 to 11 times less than real respondents with the same total and on most questionnaires endorse nearly every symptom at a middling level; on the PHQ-9 their symptoms covary less like real ones. People, honest or feigning, answer "not at all" about as often as genuine patients with the same totals, and more often than every model. Single answers are highly concentrated, and prompt changes, published personas, larger models and reasoning reduce the pattern without removing it. In interviews, patients told a severity are rated as having nearly every symptom, so an assessment agent's recognition of absent symptoms goes untested, and scored against the stated severity the agent places a quarter of them in their band, against about half of patients given a real symptom profile. Having the model word such a profile restores half to two thirds of the variation.
zh_abstract: 语言模型被用作模拟精神科患者，以培训临床医生并评估AI治疗师，并且依据合理性或总分进行评判。我们为模拟应答者提供一个框架：信息预算限制了模拟患者可能差异的程度，而“平均患者”假设——即模型以所命名状况和严重程度典型水平回答每个条目——意味着变异很小、具有该状况典型症状的完整剖面，并且总分处于或高于所述严重程度区间的顶端。我们在来自八个人类样本（包括一个临床样本和一个被指导伪装样本）的条目级数据上，在匹配总分条件下检验了这些含义。在17个模型中，模拟患者在相同总分下变异比真实应答者少1.5至11倍，并且在大多数问卷上几乎以中等水平认可每一种症状；在PHQ-9上，他们的症状协变方式与真实情况不太相似。人们，无论是诚实作答还是伪装，回答“完全没有”的频率与具有相同总分的真实患者大致相当，并且比每个模型都更频繁。单个答案高度集中，而提示词变化、已发表人格设定、更大模型和推理会减少该模式但不会消除它。在访谈中，被告知严重程度的患者被评定为几乎具有每一种症状，因此评估代理对缺失症状的识别未受检验；并且以所述严重程度为评分基准时，代理将他们中的四分之一归入其区间，而对于被给予真实症状剖面的患者，这一比例约为一半。让模型用语言表述这样的剖面可恢复一半到三分之二的变异。

title: Benchmarking CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Foundation Models for Explainable Brain Tumor MRI Classification: Calibration, Decision Analysis, and External Validation
zh_title: 脑肿瘤 MRI 分类基准：校准、决策与外部验证
summary: 在 7216 张公开脑肿瘤 MRI 上基准测试六种架构的准确率、校准、可解释性、集成与决策曲线，并进行外部验证和重复图像筛查。
key_points: 六模型测试准确率 94.5%–95.6%，两两无差异
36% 测试图像在训练集中存在近重复
去重后准确率降至 90.3%–91.7%
reason: 含外部验证且揭示数据重复问题，但为预印本基准研究，属值得一看档
abstract: Deep learning models for brain tumor MRI classification are usually compared by accuracy alone, on public datasets whose independence is rarely checked. We benchmarked six architectures: two convolutional networks (EfficientNetV2-M and ConvNeXt-V2-Tiny), two vision transformers (Swin-V2-S and ViT-L/16), and two foundation models (DINOv2-L and MedSigLIP-448), for four-class classification of 7,216 public MRI images. We assessed accuracy, calibration, explainability, ensembles, and decision curves, with every fitted quantity estimated on validation data only. Pixel-verified duplicate screening showed that 36% of the test images had a near-duplicate in the training data. Test accuracy ranged from 94.5% to 95.6%, with no pairwise difference after Holm correction, and fell to 90.3% to 91.7% on the 773 test images free of duplicates and shared patients. Ensembles did not outperform the best single model. Attribution maps passed a model-randomization test but localized expert-annotated tumors poorly. On 1,675 external BDNeuro-MRI images that did not duplicate the training data, accuracy ranged from 77.6% (MedSigLIP-448) to 95.0% (ViT-L/16), and 12 of 15 pairwise differences were significant. Internal accuracy on this public collection therefore did not distinguish the architectures, whereas the duplicate-filtered external test did.
zh_abstract: 用于脑肿瘤MRI分类的深度学习模型通常仅凭准确率进行比较，而且所用公共数据集的独立性很少经过核查。我们对六种架构进行了基准测试：两种卷积网络（EfficientNetV2-M和ConvNeXt-V2-Tiny）、两种视觉Transformer（Swin-V2-S和ViT-L/16）以及两种基础模型（DINOv2-L和MedSigLIP-448），对7,216张公开MRI图像进行四分类。我们评估了准确率、校准、可解释性、集成模型和决策曲线，每个拟合量仅在验证数据上估计。经像素验证的重复筛查显示，36%的测试图像在训练数据中存在近重复。测试准确率范围为94.5%至95.6%，经Holm校正后无两两差异，而在773张无重复且无共享患者的测试图像上降至90.3%至91.7%。集成模型未优于最佳单一模型。归因图通过了模型随机化检验，但对专家标注肿瘤的定位效果较差。在1,675张未与训练数据重复的外部BDNeuro-MRI图像上，准确率范围为77.6%（MedSigLIP-448）至95.0%（ViT-L/16），15个两两差异中有12个显著。因此，在这个公开数据集上的内部准确率未能区分这些架构，而经过重复过滤的外部测试则能够区分。

title: AgentCT: A Vision-Language Agent for Universal CT Imaging

abstract: Computed tomography (CT) restoration methods often use a single network for low-dose CT (LDCT), sparse-view CT (SVCT), and metal artifact reduction (MAR), despite the distinct physics of these degradations. We propose AgentCT, a vision-language agent that identifies the degradation and routes images to task-specific restoration models. A LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-4B controller predicts degradation type and severity, selects a specialist, and reassesses the restored image. The LDCT specialist uses an image-domain diffusion model, whereas the SVCT and MAR specialists combine projection-domain correction, data consistency, differentiable filtered back-projection, and image refinement. We evaluated the controller and specialists separately on patient-disjoint Mayo 2020 abdominal CT data across three severity levels for each degradation. The controller achieved 95.7% accuracy for degradation type and 93.9% for severity, with a 100% JSON parse rate. Using ground-truth degradation labels for routing, AgentCT achieved an overall PSNR/SSIM of 46.18 dB/0.984, compared with 44.93 dB/0.976 for AMIR and 44.29 dB/0.979 for TAMP, and attained the highest PSNR in all nine settings. For SVCT, its dual-domain specialist achieved 46.04 dB with 4.2 million parameters, compared with 44.43 dB for single-task AMIR and 43.57 dB for all-in-one AMIR with 23.5 million parameters. These results support degradation-specific CT restoration with controller-based model selection; evaluation under automatic routing and on independent clinical data remains necessary. Code is available at https://github.com/hao1635/AgentCT.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）恢复方法常对低剂量CT（low-dose CT, LDCT）、稀疏视图CT（sparse-view CT, SVCT）和金属伪影减少（metal artifact reduction, MAR）使用单一网络，尽管这些退化具有不同的物理特性。我们提出AgentCT，一种视觉-语言智能体，可识别退化类型并将图像路由至任务特定的恢复模型。经LoRA适配的Qwen3-VL-4B控制器预测退化类型和严重程度，选择专家模型，并重新评估恢复后的图像。LDCT专家模型使用图像域扩散模型，而SVCT和MAR专家模型结合投影域校正、数据一致性、可微分滤波反投影和图像细化。我们在患者不重叠的Mayo 2020腹部CT数据上，针对每种退化的三个严重程度级别，分别评估了控制器和专家模型。控制器在退化类型上的准确率为95.7%，在严重程度上的准确率为93.9%，JSON解析率为100%。使用真实退化标签进行路由时，AgentCT的总体PSNR/SSIM为46.18 dB/0.984，而AMIR为44.93 dB/0.976，TAMP为44.29 dB/0.979，并在所有九个设置中取得最高PSNR。对于SVCT，其双域专家模型以420万参数达到46.04 dB，而单任务AMIR为44.43 dB，具有2350万参数的一体化AMIR为43.57 dB。这些结果支持基于控制器模型选择的退化特异性CT恢复；仍需在自动路由下以及在独立临床数据上进行评估。代码见 https://github.com/hao1635/AgentCT。

abstract: Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/

To summarize the clinical potential, developmental risks, ethical safeguards, and nursing implications of AI use for adolescent depression and anxiety. This commentary is informed by selected peer-reviewed sources and expert recommendations on AI, mental health of adolescents, ethics, and nursing considerations. AI may have a limited adjunctive role in psychoeducation and in preliminary screening or triage when embedded in validated workflows with clinician oversight; it should not replace clinical assessment or counseling. abstract: [Compendium of continuing education in dentistry (Jamesburg, N.J. : 1995)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is moving quickly from an emerging technology to a working component of dental practice. The pressing question for clinicians is no longer whether AI will influence dentistry but how to integrate it safely, ethically, and responsibly. Building on the authors' previous article on AI and the evolving standard of care, this article, the second in a series, addresses the standard of practice-the behaviors, safeguards, and professional responsibilities-that should guide dentists who use AI-assisted technologies. The authors propose a 10-domain framework: technology selection and understanding, independent verification, human oversight, privacy and data security, patient communication, documentation, bias awareness, separation of detection from treatment, performance monitoring, and professional accountability. An eight-stage AI clinical integration cycle (select → understand → apply → verify → decide → communicate → document → monitor) translates these domains into daily workflow. Throughout, AI should serve as clinical decision support, not as an autonomous decision-maker; the dentist remains responsible for diagnosis, treatment recommendations, informed consent, and patient care.

abstract: [Advances in biochemical engineering/biotechnology] The development of biological systems often requires extensive experimental iterations and optimization, which can be resource-intensive and time-consuming. In recent years, rapid advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) have demonstrated a strong potential to address these challenges. AI technologies, particularly those that enable continuous learning from large datasets and intelligent exploration of novel solution spaces, align closely with the evolving needs of synthetic biology platforms. AI holds significant promise for analyzing complex biological features and facilitating the design of sophisticated biological systems. This review explores the current progress of AI applications in synthetic biology, focusing on its impact in areas such as part engineering, circuit engineering, metabolic engineering, and genome engineering. It also highlights several key challenges in integrating AI with synthetic biology, including issues related to standardized data, development of intelligent platforms, automation of experimentation, and enhancing predictive accuracy. The fusion of AI and synthetic biology is poised to revolutionize the "design-build-test-learn" (DBTL) cycle by accelerating the design and testing of new biological systems. Furthermore, the development of AI systems that emulate the capabilities of synthetic biologists could lead to significant breakthroughs in AI itself. As both fields continue to evolve in tandem, the convergence of AI and synthetic biology holds the potential to drive innovations that will reshape the future of biotechnology and artificial intelligence.
zh_abstract: [Advances in biochemical engineering/biotechnology] 生物系统的开发通常需要大量实验迭代和优化，这可能耗费大量资源且耗时。近年来，人工智能（AI）的快速进展已显示出应对这些挑战的强大潜力。AI技术，尤其是那些能够从大型数据集中持续学习并智能探索新解空间的技术，与合成生物学平台不断演变的需求高度契合。AI在分析复杂生物特征和促进复杂生物系统设计方面具有重大前景。本综述探讨AI在合成生物学中应用的当前进展，重点讨论其在元件工程、回路工程、代谢工程和基因组工程等领域的影响。本文还强调了将AI与合成生物学整合中的若干关键挑战，包括标准化数据、智能平台开发、实验自动化以及提高预测准确性相关的问题。AI与合成生物学的融合有望通过加速新生物系统的设计和测试，彻底改变“设计-构建-测试-学习”（DBTL）循环。此外，开发能够模拟合成生物学家能力的AI系统可能在AI本身带来重大突破。随着两个领域持续协同演进，AI与合成生物学的汇聚具有推动创新的潜力，这些创新将重塑生物技术和人工智能的未来。
