abstract: [International journal of emergency medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) adoption in medicine has substantially outpaced its formal integration into medical training programs. This editorial synthesizes the evidence on AI in medical education, examining rapid growth alongside thin long-term outcomes data and structural tensions across curriculum, assessment, and global equity. Technology dependence, institutional inequity, and the mismatch between AI-enabled training and AI-free board examinations emerge as under-addressed challenges. We propose a four-tier disclosure framework to standardize transparency in AI-assisted scholarship and argue that AI literacy now constitutes a core clinical competency. Governance scholarship must match the pace of capability research if the field is to advance responsibly.
zh_abstract: [International journal of emergency medicine] 人工智能（AI）在医学中的采用已大幅超过其正式纳入医学培训项目的速度。这篇社论综合了关于 AI 在医学教育中的证据，考察了快速增长与长期结局数据薄弱并存，以及课程、评估和全球公平方面的结构性张力。技术依赖、机构不平等，以及 AI 赋能培训与无 AI 的执业资格考试之间的不匹配，成为未被充分解决的挑战。我们提出一个四级披露框架，以标准化 AI 辅助学术工作中的透明度，并认为 AI 素养现在构成一项核心临床胜任力。如果该领域要负责任地发展，治理研究必须与能力研究保持同步。

title: Oculomics in Gastrointestinal Disorders: A narrative review.
zh_title: 胃肠道疾病中的眼组学：叙述性综述
summary: 综述汇总眼底血管口径等眼部生物标志物与胃肠疾病的关联，并讨论AI在此类标志物分析中的潜在作用。
key_points: 检索2000年至2026年2月多数据库文献
最常见标志物为眼底血管口径与动静脉比
称AI眼部标志物与胃肠疾病呈正相关
reason: 叙述性综述，结论笼统且无原始验证，属增量档
abstract: [Romanian journal of ophthalmology] We reviewed various ocular biomarkers relevant to gastrointestinal (GI) disorders and examined the potential role of artificial intelligence (AI) in detecting, integrating, and translating these biomarkers into clinical gastroenterology practice. A literature search from PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, Google Scholar, and Web of Science from the year 2000 up to February 2026 was conducted. We included published articles on ocular findings in gastrointestinal disorders and/or AI-based analysis of ocular biomarkers with gastrointestinal connections. Results suggested a positive correlation between AI-based ocular biomarkers and GI disorders. After reviewing the literature, we found that the most frequently described ocular biomarkers were retinal vascular caliber and arteriovenous ratio on fundus photography; retinal nerve fibre layer and choroidal changes on optical coherence tomography; and vessel-density changes on optical coherence tomography angiography. The persistent signal came from inflammatory bowel disease and steatotic liver disease. AI may improve image processing, feature extraction, and pattern recognition, but more multicentric studies are needed to establish definitive analogy. This review suggests that ocular biomarkers could provide a simple, non-invasive way to identify and monitor gastrointestinal diseases, especially inflammatory bowel disease and steatotic liver disease. Changes in retinal blood vessels, the retinal nerve fibre layer, the choroid, and OCTA-derived vessel density may reflect the inflammation, metabolic disturbances, and small-vessel changes associated with these conditions. However, these findings should be interpreted with caution because many existing studies included small or selected patient groups, used cross-sectional designs, applied different imaging methods, and did not consistently account for factors such as age, vascular risk, medications, or coexisting eye disease. Artificial intelligence may improve the analysis of complex eye images by identifying subtle patterns. Still, high model performance alone does not prove that these tools are accurate, reliable, or specific enough for clinical use. Future studies should therefore include large, multicentre, prospective populations, standardized imaging and reporting methods, independent external validation, and clinically meaningful outcomes. These steps will help determine whether AI-assisted oculomics can reliably support gastrointestinal screening, disease classifica
zh_abstract: 【罗马尼亚眼科杂志】我们综述了与胃肠道（GI）疾病相关的各种眼部生物标志物，并考察了人工智能（AI）在检测、整合这些生物标志物并将其转化应用于临床胃肠病学实践中的潜在作用。我们检索了 PubMed、MEDLINE、Scopus、Google Scholar 和 Web of Science 自2000年至2026年2月的文献。我们纳入已发表的关于胃肠道疾病眼部表现和/或基于AI分析具有胃肠道关联的眼部生物标志物的文章。结果提示，基于AI的眼部生物标志物与GI疾病呈正相关。文献综述后，我们发现最常描述的眼部生物标志物包括：眼底摄影上的视网膜血管口径和动静脉比值；光学相干断层扫描（OCT）上的视网膜神经纤维层和脉络膜改变；以及光学相干断层扫描血管成像（OCTA）上的血管密度改变。持续出现的信号来自炎症性肠病和脂肪性肝病。AI可能改善图像处理、特征提取和模式识别，但需要更多多中心研究来建立明确的对应关系。本综述提示，眼部生物标志物或可提供一种简单、非侵入性的方式来识别和监测胃肠道疾病，尤其是炎症性肠病和脂肪性肝病。视网膜血管、视网膜神经纤维层、脉络膜以及OCTA衍生血管密度的改变，可能反映与这些疾病相关的炎症、代谢紊乱和小血管改变。然而，这些发现应谨慎解读，因为许多现有研究纳入的是小型或经过选择的患者群体，采用横断面设计，使用不同的成像方法，并且未始终考虑年龄、血管风险、药物或共存眼病等因素。人工智能可能通过识别细微模式来改善对复杂眼部图像的分析。然而，仅凭模型性能高并不能证明这些工具足够准确、可靠或特异，可用于临床。因此，未来研究应纳入大型、多中心、前瞻性人群，采用标准化成像和报告方法，进行独立外部验证，并关注具有临床意义的结局。这些步骤将有助于确定AI辅助的眼组学（oculomics）能否可靠地支持胃肠道筛查、疾病分类

title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
zh_title: SkinMind：图探查智能体RAG用于皮肤科
summary: 预印本提出多模态智能体检索框架，通过图探查工具迭代获取文本与视觉证据支持皮肤科决策。
key_points: 编排器与图环境迭代交互检索
八类层级图探查工具
整合文本与视觉来源证据
reason: 预印本新方法，思路有新意但尚无外部验证与临床结局证据
abstract: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on one-shot retrieval from flat corpora, limiting its ability to adapt retrieval granularity, explore multi-hop relations, and integrate multimodal clinical evidence. We introduce SkinMind, a multimodal agentic RAG framework that equips policy models with human-inspired graph probing for autonomous evidence seeking. SkinMind organizes retrieval as an iterative interaction between an orchestrator and a graph environment. Through eight hierarchical graph-probing tools, the orchestrator progressively identifies relevant entities, inspects node-level information, traverses relations and paths, and retrieves source-text and visual evidence. This progressive-disclosure design allows the model to adaptively determine the retrieval modality, exploration direction, and evidence granularity while constructing a query-specific evidence subgraph. To support autonomous graph probing, we construct SkinMind-KG from a 62M-token corpus of dermatology guidelines and textbooks and 423K images, guided by a dermatologist-informed schema and a conflict-resolution mechanism. The resulting graph contains over 1.0M nodes and 2.0M edges, unifying textual, relational, and visual evidence for retrieval. Across six dermatology VQA benchmarks and two policy-model settings, SkinMind improves the average score over direct answering by 8.70 and 8.89 points with GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, respectively, while consistently outperforming competing RAG methods. Together, SkinMind and SkinMind-KG provide an effective foundation for evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning in dermatology.
zh_abstract: 可靠皮肤科 AI 需要获取分布于异构文本和视觉来源中的可验证证据。然而，传统检索增强生成（RAG）通常依赖从扁平语料库进行一次性检索，限制了其调整检索粒度、探索多跳关系和整合多模态临床证据的能力。我们提出 SkinMind，一种多模态智能体式 RAG 框架，为策略模型配备受人类启发的图探测能力，以自主寻找证据。SkinMind 将检索组织为编排器与图环境之间的迭代交互。通过八种分层图探测工具，编排器逐步识别相关实体、检查节点级信息、遍历关系和路径，并检索源文本和视觉证据。这种渐进式披露设计使模型能够在构建查询特定证据子图时自适应地确定检索模态、探索方向和证据粒度。为支持自主图探测，我们基于一个 62M token 的皮肤科指南和教科书语料库以及 423K 张图像，在皮肤科医生指导的 schema 和冲突解决机制引导下构建 SkinMind-KG。所得图包含超过 1.0M 个节点和 2.0M 条边，统一了文本、关系和视觉证据以供检索。在六个皮肤科 VQA 基准和两种策略模型设置中，SkinMind 在 GPT-5.4-mini 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash 上分别将平均得分较直接回答提高 8.70 分和 8.89 分，同时始终优于竞争的 RAG 方法。总之，SkinMind 和 SkinMind-KG 为皮肤科中基于证据的多模态推理提供了有效基础。

title: PhysioWave-T: Token-Efficient Wavelet Foundation Models for Biosignals
zh_title: PhysioWave-T：面向生理信号的小波基础模型
summary: 预印本提出token高效的小波基础模型，覆盖EEG、ECG与sEMG，报告延迟与显存显著下降且精度不降。
key_points: 尺度折叠将序列长度由(J+1)CS压缩至CS
EEG编码器30M参数，预训练超1500万窗口
在9项指标中8项领先BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM、EEGPT
reason: 有新方法且对比多个基线，但为预印本、外部验证有限，属值得一看档
abstract: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines J+1 wavelet subbands prior to tokenization, compressing sequence length from (J+1)CS to CS tokens for J levels, C channels, and S temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse montages and sampling rates, while unseen setups reuse the backbone via lightweight adapters. We pre-train a 30M-parameter EEG model on over 15M windows (19--128 channels), alongside ECG (30M) and sEMG (12M) encoders. Across four EEG routes, scale folding cuts Transformer latency by 4.0--7.2x and peak memory by 6.8--12.7x over scale expansion without accuracy loss. Our EEG encoder leads 8 of 9 metrics against BENDR, BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and surpasses LUNA-L on wearable seizure detection with fewer parameters. Reliability-aware latent fusion (RALF) further integrates summary tokens from independently pre-trained encoders via sample-adaptive weights. On SeizeIT2, RALF raises event sensitivity at 11 false alarms/h from 61.4% to 74.4% and window AUPRC from 0.321 to 0.399 over the best unimodal baseline, outperforming weighted-logit and concatenation fusion across all variants. PhysioWave-T also achieves state-of-the-art sEMG accuracies and top macro-F1 on PTB-XL Super and Chapman-Shaoxing. Code and models: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave.
zh_abstract: 我们提出PhysioWave-T，一个面向EEG、ECG和sEMG的令牌高效小波基础模型系列。动态尺度折叠在令牌化之前重组J+1个小波子带，将序列长度从(J+1)CS个令牌压缩到CS个令牌，其中J为层数、C为通道数、S为时间片段数。路由特定前端和学习到的通道名称嵌入使每种模态一个Transformer即可处理多样导联组合和采样率，而未见设置通过轻量适配器复用骨干。我们预训练了一个3000万参数的EEG模型，使用超过1500万个窗口（19--128通道），同时预训练ECG（3000万）和sEMG（1200万）编码器。在四条EEG路径上，与尺度扩展相比，尺度折叠将Transformer延迟降低4.0--7.2倍，峰值内存降低6.8--12.7倍，且无准确率损失。我们的EEG编码器在9项指标中的8项领先于BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM和EEGPT，并在可穿戴癫痫检测上以更少参数超过LUNA-L。可靠性感知潜在融合（RALF）进一步通过样本自适应权重整合来自独立预训练编码器的汇总令牌。在SeizeIT2上，相较于最佳单模态基线，RALF将在每小时11次误报下的事件灵敏度从61.4%提高到74.4%，并将窗口AUPRC从0.321提高到0.399，在所有变体中优于加权logit融合和拼接融合。PhysioWave-T还在PTB-XL Super和Chapman-Shaoxing上取得最高macro-F1，并实现最先进的sEMG准确率。代码与模型：https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave。

title: Artificial intelligence in emergency trauma perioperative management: applications, performance benchmarks, and translation barriers.
zh_title: AI在急诊创伤围手术期管理中的应用与转化障碍
summary: 综述梳理AI在创伤院前分诊、影像损伤识别、大量输血预测与并发症预警中的表现及落地障碍。
key_points: 部分任务显示AI优于传统方法但研究设计不一
外部验证性能下降、可解释性不足阻碍采用
指出基准性能虚高本身即转化障碍
reason: 同行评审综述，聚焦转化障碍有信息量，但无新数据，综述上限档
abstract: [Frontiers in surgery] This review examines the current status of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in the perioperative management of emergency trauma. Published studies suggest performance advantages of AI over traditional methods in prehospital triage, radiographic injury detection, massive transfusion prediction, and early warning of postoperative complications, although findings vary across study designs and validation settings. However, actual adoption in trauma care remains limited due to data heterogeneity, performance degradation in external validation, workflow integration challenges, lack of interpretability, and a scarcity of prospective interventional evidence. This review further argues that methodologically inflated benchmark performance constitutes an underrecognized barrier to adoption in its own right, and that bridging the implementation gap will likely require a shift from area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC)-centered reporting toward reporting sensitivity at prespecified clinical thresholds and evaluating patient outcomes in prospective interventional trials.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in surgery] 本综述考察人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）在急诊创伤围手术期管理中应用的现状。已发表的研究提示，AI 在院前分诊、影像学损伤检测、大量输血预测及术后并发症早期预警方面较传统方法具有性能优势，但不同研究设计与验证环境下的结果存在差异。然而，由于数据异质性、外部验证中的性能下降、工作流程整合困难、缺乏可解释性以及前瞻性干预证据稀缺，AI 在创伤救治中的实际应用仍然有限。本综述进一步认为，方法学上被夸大的基准性能本身构成一个尚未被充分认识的应用障碍，而弥合实施差距可能需要从以受试者工作特征曲线下面积（area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, AUC）为中心的报告，转向报告预设临床阈值下的敏感性，并在前瞻性干预试验中评估患者结局。

title: Cross-state representation learning enables prospective discovery of dynamic protein allosteric sites
zh_title: 跨构象表示学习预测动态变构位点
summary: 预印本提出跨状态位点识别基准AsBench2与深度学习框架AllositeUltra，在apo与底物结合态上Top-3位点回收率为65.2%与70.6%。
key_points: 发布跨状态变构位点识别基准AsBench2
融合结构感知语言模型与物理动力学表征
apo/底物结合态Top-3回收率65.2%、70.6%
相对提升36.4%（摘要数值被截断）
reason: 预印本新框架加自建基准，有基线对比但无湿实验验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Allosteric regulation offers multifunctional induction in therapeutic interventions, yet conformational plasticity hinders computational identification of allosteric sites. Machine learning models rely on static holo (ligand-bound) structures, generalizing poorly to apo or substrate-bound states where binding pockets are transient or cryptic. We present AsBench2, a cross-state site-recognition benchmark, and AllositeUltra, a deep learning framework integrating multimodal protein representations (combining structure-aware language models with physical dynamics) and residue-guided candidate supplementation, effectively decoupling site detection from static pocket geometry. AllositeUltra demonstrates superior generalization, achieving Top-3 site recovery rates of 65.2% and 70.6% on apo and substrate-bound structures, respectively, representing relative improvements of 36.4% and approximately 50% over the best-performing baselines. Prospective application to MAGI2 identifies a previously unrecognized interdomain allosteric pocket, validated at atomic resolution through small-molecule screening and X-ray crystallography. Proteome-wide application yields a high-confidence atlas of targetable allosteric sites, bridging the gap between structural representation learning and prospective AI-driven drug discovery.
zh_abstract: 变构调节在治疗干预中提供多功能诱导，然而构象可塑性阻碍了变构位点的计算识别。机器学习模型依赖静态全配体结合（holo）结构，对结合口袋短暂或隐蔽的载脂（apo）或底物结合状态泛化能力差。我们提出 AsBench2，一个跨状态位点识别基准，以及 AllositeUltra，一个深度学习框架，整合多模态蛋白质表示（将结构感知语言模型与物理动力学相结合）和残基引导的候选补充，有效将位点检测与静态口袋几何解耦。AllositeUltra 展现出更优的泛化能力，在 apo 和底物结合结构上分别实现 65.2% 和 70.6% 的 Top-3 位点恢复率，相较表现最佳的基线相对提升 36.4% 和约 50%。对 MAGI2 的前瞻性应用识别出一个此前未被认识的结构域间变构口袋，并通过小分子筛选和 X 射线晶体学在原子分辨率上得到验证。全蛋白质组应用产生了一个高置信度的可靶向变构位点图谱，弥合了结构表示学习与前瞻性 AI 驱动药物发现之间的差距。

title: Natural-language cohort queries on a hospital data platform: accuracy and provenance in a real-world evaluation
zh_title: 医院数据平台自然语言队列查询真实世界评估
summary: 预印本在大学医院三院区评估商用自然语言查询平台的准确性与查询级溯源。
key_points: 平台接入三所三级医院数据，遵循去标识与治理框架
25条自然语言提示针对1594例脑肿瘤队列
与人工参考SQL比对并核查执行查询可追溯性
reason: 真实世界概念验证，样本与提示量有限，属单机构内部评估
abstract: Background: Accessing routinely collected clinical data for research remains technically demanding across heterogeneous hospital systems. This proof-of-concept study aimed to evaluate the accuracy and query-level traceability of a commercial natural-language (NL) data-query platform implemented at a university hospital. Methods: An on-premises data integration platform with an NL query interface (AIRE; Briya, Tel Aviv, Israel) was connected to the institutional health data platform across three tertiary-care hospitals under an approved pseudonymization and governance framework. Implementation comprised regulatory and governance approval, and IT deployment. Twenty-five NL prompts addressing cohort identification and characterization in an adult ICD-10 C71-coded brain-tumor cohort (n = 1,594) were evaluated against manually written reference SQL and checked for a corresponding executed query in the exported log. Responses were classified into five categories. Prompts with unanswered or incorrect responses were re-posed in a new thread. Results: The platform was implemented over two years. Fifteen of 25 responses were exact (n = 11), concordant after definition alignment (n = 1), or incorrect but traceable from the logged SQL (n = 3); six were plausible but incorrect without a logged query, and four remained unanswered. No incorrect unlogged result recurred in a new thread. Across the initial and repeat evaluations, 22 of 23 logged responses were correct or traceable, whereas all eight unlogged responses were incorrect. Conclusions: Implementation was feasible but required substantial local institutional preparation. The NL interface reproduced SQL-derived results when definitions were explicit, while query-level provenance and verification of the displayed result were critical for identifying unreliable outputs.
zh_abstract: 【背景】获取常规收集的临床数据用于研究，在异质性医院系统之间仍具有技术挑战。这项概念验证研究旨在评估在一所大学医院实施的商业化自然语言（NL）数据查询平台的准确性及查询级可追溯性。【方法】在经批准的假名化与治理框架下，将带有NL查询界面的本地部署数据集成平台（AIRE；Briya, Tel Aviv, Israel）连接至三家三级医院组成的机构健康数据平台。实施包括监管与治理批准以及IT部署。针对成人ICD-10 C71编码的脑肿瘤队列（n = 1,594）中队列识别与特征描述的25条NL提示词，与人工编写的参考SQL进行对照评估，并在导出日志中检查是否存在对应已执行查询。回答被分为五类。未回答或回答错误的提示词在新线程中重新提出。【结果】该平台实施耗时两年。25条回答中，15条为完全一致（n = 11）、定义对齐后一致（n = 1）或虽不正确但可从记录的SQL追溯（n = 3）；6条看似合理但不正确且无记录查询，4条仍无回答。在新线程中未再出现不正确的无记录结果。在初始和重复评估中，23条有记录的回答里有22条正确或可追溯，而所有8条无记录的回答均不正确。【结论】实施可行，但需要大量本地机构准备工作。当定义明确时，NL界面可重现SQL推导出的结果，而查询级溯源以及对所显示结果的核验对于识别不可靠输出至关重要。

title: DecoyOpt: A two-stage pipeline for decoy-aware enzyme discrimination and EC number prediction
zh_title: DecoyOpt：诱饵感知酶判别与EC号预测
summary: 提出两阶段流程DecoyOpt，用ESM3生成功能位点诱饵，先区分真实酶再对比学习分配EC号。
key_points: 评估16个蛋白语言模型与三种数据划分
以分类与排序损失训练MLP筛除诱饵
GraphPart 40%划分下MCC 0.899、诱饵FPR 6.17%
reason: 预印本新方法且含基线对比与严格划分，证据限于计算评估
abstract: Accurate and efficient EC number prediction is essential for elucidating the catalytic roles of enzymes. Although similarity-based and deep learning-based approaches have advanced this task, they often fail to distinguish active enzymes from closely related decoys inactivated by local functional-site mutations, leading to high false-positive rates (FPRs). We propose DecoyOpt, a two-stage pipeline for decoy-aware enzyme discrimination and EC number prediction. Specifically, we generated putatively inactive functional-site decoys using ESM3 and evaluated 16 protein language models across three splits. An MLP trained with classification and ranking losses distinguishes enzymes from unannotated proteins and decoys before a contrastive learning model assigns EC numbers to predicted enzymes. On the most stringent GraphPart 40% split, DecoyOpt achieves an MCC of 0.899 and a D0 decoy FPR of 6.17%, outperforming retrained baselines. Across all splits, it outperforms these baselines in EC number prediction on the full test set while maintaining performance close to CLEAN on the enzyme subset. It also correctly annotates all four wild-type enzymes and rejects all eight inactive or nearly inactive variants. We believe that DecoyOpt has potential for annotating uncharacterized proteins and their variants, with applications in genomics, synthetic biology, and biocatalysis.
zh_abstract: 准确且高效的EC编号预测对于阐明酶的催化作用至关重要。尽管基于相似性和基于深度学习的方法已推进了这一任务，但它们往往无法区分活性酶与因局部功能位点突变而失活的密切 related 诱饵，导致高假阳性率（FPR）。我们提出DecoyOpt，一种用于诱饵感知的酶判别和EC编号预测的两阶段流程。具体而言，我们使用ESM3生成了推定的失活功能位点诱饵，并在三个划分上评估了16个蛋白质语言模型。一个以分类损失和排序损失训练的MLP，在对比学习模型为预测为酶的蛋白质分配EC编号之前，区分酶与未注释蛋白质及诱饵。在最严格的GraphPart 40%划分上，DecoyOpt达到MCC 0.899和D0诱饵FPR 6.17%，优于重新训练的基线。在所有划分上，它在完整测试集上的EC编号预测中优于这些基线，同时在酶子集上保持接近CLEAN的性能。它还能正确注释全部四种野生型酶，并拒绝全部八种失活或几乎失活的变体。我们认为DecoyOpt具有注释未表征蛋白质及其变体的潜力，可应用于基因组学、合成生物学和生物催化。

title: HV-MultiScaleGNN: A Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network Framework for Host-Virus Protein-Protein Interactions Prediction
zh_title: 多尺度图神经网络预测宿主-病毒蛋白互作
summary: 提出仅依赖异质互作网络拓扑的多尺度图神经网络框架HV-MultiScaleGNN，用于预测宿主-病毒蛋白互作。
key_points: 将互作预测建模为异质网络链接预测问题
比较局部、全局与局部+全局三种图表示
不依赖蛋白序列与结构等不完整信息
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本、缺乏湿实验验证，值得一看档
abstract: Accurate identification of HV-PPIs is essential for understanding viral infection mechanisms and for developing antiviral therapeutic discovery. However, the experimental identification process is often time-consuming and expensive, while many computational approaches depend on incomplete protein sequences, structural and interaction information. Here, we present HV-MultiScaleGNN, a topology-driven multi-scale GNN framework for HV-PPIs prediction that operates exclusively on the topology of a heterogeneous interaction network. The framework formulates HV-PPIs prediction as a heterogeneous link prediction problem by integrating the human interactome with experimentally validated HV-PPIs. HV-MultiScaleGNN systematically investigates three complementary graph representation strategies, viz. Local view, Global view and an integrated Local+Global view. The Local view employs one-hop relation-aware graph attention to model fine-grained neighbourhood interactions. The Global view captures higher-order structural dependencies through propagation-based neighbourhood aggregation. The integrated representation combines both views to jointly encode local connectivity and global topological context within a unified embedding space, enabling relation-specific link prediction without relying on sequence- or structure-derived features. Experiments on large-scale HV-PPIs datasets evaluate all three strategies using discrimination, calibration, and ranking metrics. The Local view achieved the best discriminative performance (AUROC = 0.9444, AUPRC = 0.9422), whereas the Global view exhibited the lowest ECE (0.0379). The integrated Local+Global view provided consistently strong predictive performance (AUROC = 0.9378, AUPRC = 0.9356). Comparative evaluation against representative graph representation learning methods showed competitive predictive performance. Furthermore, interfacial interactions were identified using protein-protein docking and atomistic-level understanding was explored. Moreover, GO and KEGG enrichment provided additional functional insights into the selected host proteins. The proposed framework enables systematic evaluation of complementary graph representation strategies for heterogeneous biological link prediction and helps experimental researchers to delineate novel HV-PPIs.
zh_abstract: 准确识别 HV-PPIs 对于理解病毒感染机制和开展抗病毒治疗发现至关重要。然而，实验鉴定过程往往耗时且昂贵，而许多计算方法依赖不完整的蛋白质序列、结构和相互作用信息。在此，我们提出 HV-MultiScaleGNN，一种用于 HV-PPIs 预测的拓扑驱动多尺度 GNN 框架，其仅基于异质相互作用网络的拓扑运行。该框架通过将人类相互作用组与经实验验证的 HV-PPIs 整合，把 HV-PPIs 预测表述为异质链接预测问题。HV-MultiScaleGNN 系统研究三种互补的图表示策略，即局部视图、全局视图以及集成的局部+全局视图。局部视图采用一跳关系感知图注意力来建模细粒度邻域相互作用。全局视图通过基于传播的邻域聚合捕获高阶结构依赖。集成表示结合两种视图，在统一嵌入空间中联合编码局部连通性和全局拓扑背景，从而能够在不依赖序列或结构衍生特征的情况下进行关系特异性链接预测。在大规模 HV-PPIs 数据集上的实验使用判别、校准和排序指标评估所有三种策略。局部视图取得了最佳判别性能（AUROC = 0.9444，AUPRC = 0.9422），而全局视图表现出最低的 ECE（0.0379）。集成的局部+全局视图提供了持续强劲的预测性能（AUROC = 0.9378，AUPRC = 0.9356）。与代表性图表示学习方法的比较评估显示出有竞争力的预测性能。此外，利用蛋白质-蛋白质对接识别界面相互作用，并探索了原子水平理解。而且，GO 和 KEGG 富集为所选宿主蛋白提供了额外功能见解。所提出的框架能够系统评估用于异质生物链接预测的互补图表示策略，并帮助实验研究人员描绘新的 HV-PPIs。

title: Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular Optical Coherence Tomography
zh_title: 可微逆渲染从血管内OCT恢复组织内在属性
summary: 预印本提出通过可微物理前向模型梯度下降，从单张OCT图像逐像素恢复光学衰减系数，并用解析解与5个体模验证。
key_points: 以可微物理前向模型反演单张OCT图像的逐像素衰减系数
与解析解对照，并在五个体外体模上验证
目标是摆脱依赖简化光-组织模型的闭式反演
reason: 有新意的预印本成像方法，仅体模与解析验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical images encode intrinsic tissue properties that indicate disease progression, yet these properties remain entangled with the system-dependent physics of image formation. Differentiable inverse rendering asks whether they are recoverable by inverting the imaging system's forward physics rather than through post-hoc correction. We address this in optical coherence tomography (OCT), focusing on the optical attenuation coefficient, a per-pixel marker of pathology and cellular composition. Conventional recovery relies on closed-form inversions limited to simplified light-tissue models, or learned methods coupled to specific imaging configurations. We instead recover per-pixel attenuation from a single OCT image by gradient descent through a differentiable physics-based forward model. We verified the method against analytical solutions, validated it on five in vitro phantoms, and applied it without modification to 29{,}269 clinical intravascular OCT images from 128 patients. The inversion needs no training data or segmentations and is portable across platforms and retrospective archives. Replacing the forward model or recovering another optical parameter leaves the optimization procedure unchanged. We demonstrate per-pixel recovery is tractable because gradient information scales to this high-dimensional problem, where gradient-free methods become intractable. Our work supports quantitative tissue characterization from OCT images and provides a framework for extension across imaging modalities and organ systems.
zh_abstract: 医学图像编码了指示疾病进展的组织内在特性，然而这些特性仍与依赖系统的图像形成物理过程纠缠在一起。可微分逆向渲染（differentiable inverse rendering）提出的问题是：能否通过反演成像系统的前向物理过程，而非通过事后校正，来恢复这些特性。我们在光学相干断层扫描（OCT）中处理这一问题，聚焦于光学衰减系数——一种逐像素的病理学和细胞组成标志物。传统恢复依赖仅限于简化光-组织模型的闭式反演，或与特定成像配置耦合的学习方法。我们则通过对可微分、基于物理的前向模型进行梯度下降，从单张OCT图像中恢复逐像素衰减。我们对照解析解验证了该方法，在五个体外体模（phantom）上进行了验证，并在未做任何修改的情况下将其应用于来自128名患者的29,269张临床血管内OCT图像。该反演无需训练数据或分割，且可跨平台和回顾性档案移植。替换前向模型或恢复另一种光学参数不会改变优化过程。我们证明逐像素恢复是可行的，因为梯度信息可扩展到这一高维问题，而无梯度方法在此变得难以处理。我们的工作支持从OCT图像进行定量组织表征，并提供了一个可扩展到跨成像模态和器官系统的框架。

title: Decisions by Discrimination: Differential Evidence for Medical Reasoning
zh_title: 判别式证据：医学推理的差异化证据检索
summary: 提出面向医学选择题的检索式差异化证据框架，抽取选项特异证据并组织为简明提示。
key_points: 针对选项间证据重叠、仅少数决定因素可区分正确答案的问题
抽取各选项特异差异证据并构造精简证据提示用于作答
与现有检索式与推理导向方法相比侧重差异化证据
reason: 方法有新意但仅在医学选择题场景，摘要未给外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied for clinical decision support, and medical question answering provides a testbed for evaluating this capability. In particular, medical multiple-choice questions (MCQs) reflect a core challenge in clinical decision-making: plausible options often share overlapping evidence, while only a few decisive factors distinguish the correct option from incorrect ones. However, existing retrieval-based and reasoning-oriented methods mainly focus on supplying broadly relevant knowledge or eliciting reasoning paths, rather than identifying the compact differential evidence that separates confusing alternatives. In this work, we present a retrieval-grounded differential evidence framework for medical MCQs. Our method extracts option-specific pieces of differential evidence and organizes them into concise evidence prompts for answer selection. This design better aligns external knowledge with differential reasoning while reducing irrelevant context. Experiments show consistent accuracy gains across multiple datasets and target LLMs. Ablation studies further show that our framework outperforms both directly using retrieved evidence chunks and closed-source LLM-generated general hints, and that its improvements are not solely explained by answer-proximal guidance, but are consistent with differential evidence serving as a compact aid for reasoning over competing alternatives. Our findings also offer insights for medical reasoning and other decision-making settings with multiple possible choices.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）正日益被研究用于临床决策支持，而医学问答为评估这一能力提供了试验平台。具体而言，医学多项选择题（MCQs）反映了临床决策中的一项核心挑战：看似合理的选项往往共享重叠证据，而只有少数决定性因素能将正确选项与错误选项区分开来。然而，现有的基于检索和面向推理的方法主要侧重于提供广泛相关的知识或引出推理路径，而不是识别将易混淆备选选项区分开来的紧凑鉴别证据。在本工作中，我们提出一个基于检索的鉴别证据框架，用于医学MCQs。我们的方法提取选项特异的鉴别证据片段，并将其组织为简洁的证据提示用于答案选择。该设计更好地将外部知识与鉴别推理对齐，同时减少无关上下文。实验表明，在多个数据集和目标LLMs上均获得一致的准确率提升。消融研究进一步表明，我们的框架优于直接使用检索到的证据块以及闭源LLM生成的一般性提示，并且其改进不能仅由接近答案的引导来解释，而与鉴别证据作为对竞争性备选选项进行推理的紧凑辅助相一致。我们的发现也为医学推理以及其他具有多个可能选择的决策场景提供了见解。

title: RadRef: A Reference-Free Metric for Radiology Report Generation
zh_title: RadRef：无参考放射报告生成评价指标
summary: 提出无需参考报告的无参考评价指标 RadRef，按临床指征相关性对报告陈述加权打分，并在 ReXVal 与 MIMIC-CXR 上与放射科医生排序做一致性比较。
key_points: 以图像导出的发现置信度替代参考报告评分
ReXVal 上同片报告对与医生排序一致率 73.1%
遗漏发现维度 Kendall tau-b 0.295，读者间为 0.386
reason: 新评价方法且有医生标注对比，但为预印本、无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: AI-generated radiology reports are usually evaluated by comparison with a radiologist-authored reference, leaving no way to score them when no reference exists. We introduce RadRef, a reference-free metric that scores report claims against image-derived beliefs over a clinical finding vocabulary, weighted by relevance to the clinical indication. On ReXVal, RadRef achieves 73.1% agreement on non-tied same-radiograph report pairs with radiologist rankings, comparable to leading reference-based metrics overall. It is also competitive on false findings and has its clearest relative result on omissions (missed findings). We further evaluate 100 model-generated and 100 radiologist-authored reports from 100 MIMIC-CXR studies, all independently annotated by two board-certified radiologists. On omissions, RadRef attains Kendall's tau-b = 0.295, against 0.386 between the two readers themselves, and no compared metric differs significantly from RadRef on this target. The same image-grounded representation provides a false-finding readout, RadRef-FF, with tau-b = 0.32 on ReXVal and 0.29 in the reader study, without requiring a reference. Controlled perturbations confirm that RadRef depends on the radiograph, report, and clinical indication. RadRef enables image-grounded evaluation before a radiologist-authored reference exists, supporting quality monitoring of report-generation systems in clinical settings, and complements reference-based metrics when one is available.
zh_abstract: AI生成的放射学报告通常通过与放射科医师撰写的参考报告进行比较来评估，这使得在没有参考时无法对其评分。我们提出RadRef，这是一种无参考指标，它根据图像推导出的、在临床发现词汇表上的信念来对报告中的主张评分，并按与临床指征的相关性加权。在ReXVal上，对于非平局的同一放射影像报告对，RadRef与放射科医师排名达到73.1%的一致性，总体上与领先的基于参考的指标相当。它在虚假发现（false findings）上也具有竞争力，并在遗漏（漏诊发现）上具有最清晰的相对结果。我们进一步评估了来自100项MIMIC-CXR研究的100份模型生成报告和100份放射科医师撰写的报告，全部由两名委员会认证的放射科医师独立标注。在遗漏方面，RadRef达到Kendall's tau-b = 0.295，而两名阅片者彼此之间为0.386；在这一目标上，没有比较指标与RadRef存在显著差异。同一基于图像的表示提供了一个虚假发现读出值RadRef-FF，在ReXVal上tau-b = 0.32，在阅片者研究中为0.29，且不需要参考。受控扰动证实RadRef依赖于放射影像、报告和临床指征。RadRef能够在放射科医师撰写的参考尚不存在时进行基于图像的评估，支持临床环境中报告生成系统的质量监测，并在有参考时补充基于参考的指标。

title: Uni-Loc: Weakly Supervised 3D CT Pathology Localization via Spatially Grounded Vision-Language Classification
zh_title: Uni-Loc：弱监督三维CT病灶定位
summary: 提出视觉-语言框架Uni-Loc，仅用扫描级监督统一病理分类与3D定位，在355例标注CT的五项任务上体素级AUROC达96.1%。
key_points: 扫描级弱监督联合分类与三维定位
令牌到体素上采样实现高分辨率定位
五项任务355例CT，体素AUROC 96.1%
reason: 预印本新方法含基线对比，但样本仅355例、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate localization of abnormalities in three-dimensional (3D) CT scans is essential for linking automated predictions with clinically relevant pathological findings. We propose Uni-Loc, a vision-language framework that unifies pathology classification and 3D localization using scan-level supervision. Uni-Loc derives both predictions and localization maps from spatial similarities between pathology-conditioned queries and image features. A token-to-voxel upsampling module enables high-resolution localization, while gradient-guided thresholding identifies pathology regions without additional learned parameters. Evaluated on five localization tasks comprising 355 annotated CT scans, Uni-Loc achieves macro-averaged voxel-level AUROC/AUPR of 96.1\%/34.5\%, outperforming relevance propagation (80.7%/13.9%) and gradient saliency (88.7%/8.1%). Uni-Loc also achieves classification AUROC of 88.39% on CT-RATE and 78.03% on RAD-ChestCT, improving over a matched baseline. These results demonstrate effective 3D pathology localization without requiring pathology-specific voxel-level supervision.
zh_abstract: 在三维（3D）CT 扫描中准确定位异常对于将自动预测与临床相关病理发现联系起来至关重要。我们提出 Uni-Loc，一种视觉-语言框架，利用扫描级监督统一病理分类和 3D 定位。Uni-Loc 从病理条件化查询与图像特征之间的空间相似性中推导预测和定位图。令牌到体素的上采样模块实现高分辨率定位，而梯度引导阈值化无需额外学习参数即可识别病理区域。在包含 355 例标注 CT 扫描的五项定位任务上评估，Uni-Loc 达到宏平均体素级 AUROC/AUPR 为 96.1%/34.5%，优于相关性传播（80.7%/13.9%）和梯度显著性（88.7%/8.1%）。Uni-Loc 在 CT-RATE 上还达到分类 AUROC 88.39%，在 RAD-ChestCT 上达到 78.03%，优于匹配的基线。这些结果表明，无需病理特异性体素级监督即可实现有效的 3D 病理定位。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
zh_title: 多轮临床智能体的安全强化学习
summary: 在三个模拟临床多轮环境中比较密集奖励与结果奖励，发现仅结果奖励易致过早决策与漏检高风险病例。
key_points: 构建三个可控多轮临床决策模拟环境
结果奖励易致过早承诺与单问题坍缩
对降低不确定性的提问给密集奖励更优
reason: 方法有新意且含对照，但仅在模拟环境验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.
zh_abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习越来越多地用于改进语言模型推理，但其对序贯决策过程的影响仍知之甚少。我们在临床多轮智能体中研究这一问题，这些智能体必须决定请求哪些信息、何时停止收集证据以及采取哪种行动。我们引入三个受控环境：药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查和剂量滴定，每个环境都有隐藏临床状态、查询成本、精确自适应预言机和确定性结果验证器。在这些任务中，仅基于结果的分组相对策略优化通常提高聚合奖励，同时产生不良流程，包括过早承诺、单问题崩溃以及在罕见高风险病例上的失败。在诊断中，与仅基于结果的强化学习相比，对降低不确定性的问题分配密集信用，在三个训练种子上提高了留出价值和中等病例支持，且未出现仅基于结果训练中观察到的高风险种子崩溃。将探索与利用分离进一步提高了最佳检查点的高风险支持，但代价是在低严重度病例上过度收集信息。额外实验表明，过程信用的最优强度取决于任务；在已经仔细收集信息的监督预热之后，强化学习通过削减问题提高聚合奖励，同时降低高风险性能；并且强化学习不能可靠修复来自有偏监督数据的罕见行为差距。因此，可验证的最终结果不足以训练可靠的多轮智能体：奖励设计必须考虑用于得出答案的流程，评估必须区分自适应信息收集与利用奖励的捷径。

title: Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?
zh_title: LLM直接写出医学影像分类器权重
summary: 预印本提出权重空间编程：不让模型看影像，由LLM一次性生成LeNet权重，并在7项医学影像分类任务上与零样本及常规训练基线比较。
key_points: LLM单次回复生成网络权重，不使用影像数据
覆盖胸片、乳腺超声、腹部CT、盆腔MRI共7任务
对照零样本MedSigLIP与Adam训练的同架构网络
摘要截断，具体结果数值未完整给出
reason: 预印本新方法且设多基线对比，但结果细节缺失，属值得一看档
abstract: Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能否仅凭医学知识、在没有任何训练数据的情况下写出医学图像分类器的参数？此类分类器通常需要标注图像，而这些图像成本高昂且往往不可获得。我们通过权重空间编程（WSP）研究这一问题，其中 LLM 直接写出或调整神经网络的权重和偏置，而不在训练数据上进行优化。Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 各自在单次回复中生成一个小型 LeNet 风格 CNN 的参数，不使用工具，也无法访问任何图像。我们将这些网络与零样本 MedSigLIP 以及使用 Adam 优化器在标签上训练的同一架构进行比较，涵盖四种模态的 7 项分类任务：胸部 X 线、乳腺超声和腹部 CT（均来自 MedMNIST），以及盆腔 MRI（SynthUterus）。LLM 写出的网络在所有六项 MedMNIST 任务上均高于随机水平，Opus 和 Astra 的平均测试 AUC 分别为 0.719 和 0.711。两种模型在 6 项任务中的 5 项上优于 MedSigLIP，同时使用的参数少超过 10,000 倍。然而，同一网络仅用 256 张标注图像通过 Adam 训练后，在每项 MedMNIST 任务上均获得更高的 AUC（平均 AUC 0.828）。在 SynthUterus 上，Opus 达到 AUC 0.764，而 Astra 因系统性错误低于随机水平（AUC 0.136）。这些结果表明，LLM 可以写出功能性的医学分类器，但尚不能替代训练数据。我们在 https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical 发布了方案、日志和所有生成的权重。

title: The Dark Matter of Clinical Data: An Identification Limit on Disentangling Physiology from Care Process in electronic health records
zh_title: 临床数据的暗物质：EHR中生理与诊疗流程的可识别极限
summary: 预印本形式化EHR中潜在生理与开单流程的纠缠，论证单一数据集无法识别二者的信息划分。
key_points: 构建含潜在生理、开单意图与实测值的数据生成模型
证明无法从单一数据集区分“数值”与“开单”通道
对满足Williams-Beer公理的冗余度量给出固定结论
reason: 方法学理论预印本有新意，但无实验验证与外部评估
abstract: Representations learned from electronic health record (EHR) data encode patient physiology together with the clinical process that decides what is measured, when, and for whom. We formalize the data-generating process with latent physiology, ordering intent, laboratory values that exist only when measured, a learned representation, and clinical environments, and analyze two strategies for undoing this entanglement. First, no division of the information carried by laboratory "value" and "ordering" channels is identified from a single dataset: when ordering depends on the analyte, its distribution among untested patients is not recoverable, and a sentinel code for the undefined recorded value makes it carry all the entropy of the ordering indicator, fixing partial information decomposition (PID) for every redundancy measure satisfying the Williams-Beer axioms and invariant under injective re-encoding. Second, cross-site invariance of representation-conditional outcomes is a falsifiable implication of biological invariance taken jointly with exclusion and representation-sufficiency conditions, but not an identification strategy: we construct observationally equivalent models that disagree about biological invariance, whether the invariance test fails or passes. For binary physiology this happens exactly when case mix differs, the representation is lossy, and physiology affects the outcome. A worked example yields a 9.6-percentage-point cross-site gap under an unchanged biological mechanism. Tests performed for every patient remove the ordering gate, and measured tests can restore identification: biological invariance is identified when a test exactly summarizes outcome-relevant physiology, or, for binary physiology, when two tests with independent errors are available at sites with different case mix. Cross-site analyses should be reported as tests of a stated joint hypothesis.
zh_abstract: 从电子健康记录（EHR）数据学到的表示编码了患者生理状态，以及决定测量什么、何时测量、对谁测量的临床过程。我们用潜在生理状态、开具检验的意图、仅在测量时才存在的实验室值、学习到的表示以及临床环境来形式化数据生成过程，并分析两种解除这种纠缠的策略。首先，从单一数据集中无法识别由实验室“值”和“开具检验”通道所携带信息的任何划分：当开具检验取决于分析物时，未检测患者中的该分析物分布不可恢复，而用于未定义记录值的哨兵编码使其携带开具检验指示变量的全部熵，从而对每一个满足Williams-Beer公理且在内射重编码下不变的冗余度量，固定了部分信息分解（PID）。其次，表示条件结局的跨站点不变性是生物不变性与排除条件和表示充分性条件联合成立时的一个可证伪推论，但不是一种识别策略：我们构建了在观察上等价的模型，这些模型在生物不变性上不一致，无论该不变性检验失败还是通过。对于二值生理状态，这恰好发生在病例组合不同、表示有损且生理状态影响结局时。一个示例在生物机制不变的情况下产生了9.6个百分点的跨站点差距。对每位患者都执行的检验消除了开具检验的门控，而实际测量的检验可以恢复识别：当一项检验恰好概括了与结局相关的生理状态时，或者对于二值生理状态，当不同病例组合的站点可获得两项具有独立误差的检验时，生物不变性可被识别。跨站点分析应作为对明确陈述的联合假设的检验来报告。

title: Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System for ICU Discharge Risk Assessment
zh_title: 面向ICU出院风险的操作感知多模态CDSS
summary: 预印本构建多智能体RAG临床决策支持系统，结合科室负荷与入院流程评估ICU出院风险。
key_points: 多智能体协作+RAG清洗病程记录模板噪声
纳入科室工作负荷、入院流程、生命体征与ICD/DRG
针对约10.5%再入院率的严重类别不平衡
reason: 预印本有新方法且结合运营上下文，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Unplanned 30-day intensive care unit (ICU) readmission is a critical benchmark for evaluating healthcare quality. Most predictive models assume readmission risk depends solely on a patient's individual pathophysiological state, ignoring hospital operational context and resource capacity. In practice, discharge decisions are dynamic trade-offs between patient stability and bed turnover pressures. To address this gap, we develop an Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for ICU discharge risk assessment. The system combines multi-agent collaborative extraction with self-evolving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to eliminate template noise from progress notes, while constructing departmental workload indicators alongside admission flow features, continuous vital signs, and sparse medical codes (ICD/DRG). Addressing severe class imbalance (about 10.5% readmissions) and alarm fatigue, we implement data normalization, class reweighting, and decision-threshold calibration. In 20 independent runs across 20,000 ICU stays from MIMIC-III, empirical findings demonstrate that: vital signs alone have limited predictive capacity under real-world class imbalance (PR-AUC of 0.1387 +/- 0.0086); directly concatenating raw text embeddings degrades decision tree performance (XGBoost and LightGBM PR-AUC drop to 0.3893 and 0.4030); whereas an end-to-end multimodal fine-tuning architecture (Transformer E2E FineTune) utilizing layer-wise parameter freezing and differential learning rates reverses text negative transfer, achieving the highest AUROC of 0.8288 +/- 0.0110, PR-AUC of 0.4373 +/- 0.0310, and F1-Score of 0.4757 +/- 0.0196. Operational indicators supply independent risk signals, laying an engineering foundation for high-utility clinical decision support tools.
zh_abstract: 非计划 30 天重症监护病房（ICU）再入院是评估医疗质量的关键基准。大多数预测模型假设再入院风险仅取决于患者个体的病理生理状态，忽略了医院运营背景和资源能力。在实践中，出院决策是患者稳定性与床位周转压力之间的动态权衡。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了一个用于 ICU 出院风险评估的运营感知多模态临床决策支持系统（CDSS）。该系统结合多智能体协作提取与自进化检索增强生成（RAG），以消除病程记录中的模板噪声，同时构建科室工作量指标以及入院流程特征、连续生命体征和稀疏医疗编码（ICD/DRG）。针对严重类别不平衡（约 10.5% 再入院）和警报疲劳，我们实施了数据归一化、类别重加权和决策阈值校准。在来自 MIMIC-III 的 20,000 次 ICU 住院的 20 次独立运行中，实证结果表明：在真实世界类别不平衡下，仅生命体征的预测能力有限（PR-AUC 为 0.1387 +/- 0.0086）；直接拼接原始文本嵌入会降低决策树性能（XGBoost 和 LightGBM 的 PR-AUC 降至 0.3893 和 0.4030）；而采用逐层参数冻结和差异化学习率的端到端多模态微调架构（Transformer E2E FineTune）扭转了文本负迁移，实现了最高的 AUROC 0.8288 +/- 0.0110、PR-AUC 0.4373 +/- 0.0310 和 F1 分数 0.4757 +/- 0.0196。运营指标提供了独立的风险信号，为高实用性的临床决策支持工具奠定了工程基础。

title: Is a CNN-Transformer Ensemble Worth It When a Chest X-Ray Foundation Model Is Available?
zh_title: 胸片基础模型在手，CNN-Transformer 集成还值得吗
summary: 在 NIH ChestX-ray14 患者不重叠划分上，比较 ImageNet 预训练骨干集成与胸片基础模型 EVA-X-S 的多标签分类表现与成本。
key_points: EVA-X-S 单模型宏 AUROC 0.828 高于五模型集成 0.814
集成延迟约 7.8 倍、参数约 10 倍
差异用患者层面配对自助法估计
reason: 设计严谨的单一公开数据集对比基准，无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Ensembles of ImageNet-pretrained convolutional networks and Vision Transformers are a common way to improve multi-label chest X-ray classification. We ask whether such an ensemble is still worth its cost when a model pretrained on chest radiographs is available. On the official patient-disjoint split of NIH ChestX-ray14 (25,596 test images, 2,797 patients), we train five ImageNet-pretrained backbones and the EVA-X-S foundation model with validation-only model selection, compare five fusion rules, and estimate every difference with a patient-level paired bootstrap. EVA-X-S alone reached a test macro-AUROC of 0.828; the five-model ensemble reached 0.814 (difference -0.0136, 95% CI -0.0178 to -0.0098) at about 7.8 times the summed backbone latency and ten times the parameters. Averaging the five ImageNet models with EVA-X-S changed AUROC by -0.0056 (-0.0095 to -0.0021). With all five ImageNet backbones trained with the EVA-X-S recipe, their ensemble scored 0.817, still -0.0109 (-0.0142 to -0.0076) below EVA-X-S, and across three seeds EVA-X-S varied by at most 0.001 AUROC. Under the ImageNet models' recipe, however, EVA-X-S fell to 0.798. Our full-stacking configuration never outperformed calibrated averaging. In this setting, the tested ImageNet ensembles did not improve on a single chest X-ray foundation model fine-tuned with its own recipe.
zh_abstract: ImageNet 预训练卷积网络和视觉 Transformer 的集成是改进多标签胸部 X 射线分类的常用方法。我们追问：当已有在胸部 X 射线片上预训练的模型可用时，这种集成是否仍然值得其成本。在 NIH ChestX-ray14 的官方患者不重叠划分（25,596 张测试图像，2,797 名患者）上，我们仅基于验证集进行模型选择，训练五个 ImageNet 预训练骨干网络和 EVA-X-S 基础模型，比较五种融合规则，并用患者水平配对 bootstrap 估计每个差异。单独 EVA-X-S 达到测试宏 AUROC 0.828；五模型集成达到 0.814（差异 -0.0136，95% CI -0.0178 至 -0.0098），而骨干网络延迟总和约为其7.8倍，参数量为其10倍。将五个 ImageNet 模型与 EVA-X-S 平均后，AUROC 变化为 -0.0056（-0.0095 至 -0.0021）。当所有五个 ImageNet 骨干网络均使用 EVA-X-S 的训练方案训练时，其集成得分为 0.817，仍比 EVA-X-S 低 -0.0109（-0.0142 至 -0.0076）；在三个随机种子间，EVA-X-S 的 AUROC 变化至多为0.001。然而，在 ImageNet 模型的训练方案下，EVA-X-S 降至 0.798。我们的全堆叠配置从未优于校准平均。在此设置下，所测试的 ImageNet 集成并未优于单个使用其自身训练方案微调的胸部 X 射线基础模型。

title: BioMARS 2.0: a robotic biologist for formulating and adapting biological experiments
zh_title: BioMARS 2.0：可制定并调整实验的机器人生物学家
summary: 提出人在回路的多智能体机器人系统，将文献驱动的实验决策、机器人执行与图像表型反馈闭环连接，用于生物实验的方案生成与参数调整。
key_points: 生成有文献依据、可追溯的实验方案
依据图像表型反馈调整培养条件
四个模型后端上专家评审方案质量提升
reason: 新颖多智能体实验系统预印本，专家评审但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Biological experimentation is not reducible to a single optimization problem, but requires decisions at multiple levels of abstraction: translating scientific knowledge into experimental procedures, adapting culture conditions to measured phenotypes and selecting interventions that test biological hypotheses. Automating experimental execution does not, by itself, determine which experiments should be performed next or how they should change in response to biological feedback. Here we introduce BioMARS, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent robotic system that connects knowledge-guided experimental decision-making with robotic execution and biological feedback. At the procedural level, BioMARS generated literature-grounded protocols and traceable action plans, improving expert-reviewed protocol quality scores across four model backends. At the parametric level, BioMARS used image-derived phenotypes from robotic retinal organoid culture to select subsequent experimental conditions, with higher reported scores in later rounds of the three-round experiment. At the intervention level, BioMARS nominated drug-repurposing candidates from biomedical evidence and advanced six candidates to wet-lab testing by researchers. Together, these studies demonstrate feedback-driven robotic biological experimentation within a framework that supports decisions about experimental procedures, culture conditions and biological interventions.
zh_abstract: 生物实验不能化约为单一的优化问题，而是需要在多个抽象层次上作出决策：将科学知识转化为实验流程、使培养条件适应测得的表型，以及选择可检验生物学假设的干预措施。自动化实验执行本身并不能决定下一步应进行哪些实验，也不能决定这些实验应如何根据生物学反馈而改变。在此，我们介绍BioMARS，一个人在回路（human-in-the-loop）中的多智能体机器人系统，它将知识引导的实验决策与机器人执行和生物学反馈连接起来。在流程层面，BioMARS生成了有文献依据的方案和可追踪的行动计划，在四个模型后端上提高了专家评审的方案质量评分。在参数层面，BioMARS利用来自机器人视网膜类器官培养的图像衍生表型来选择后续实验条件，并在三轮实验的后期轮次中报告了更高的评分。在干预层面，BioMARS从生物医学证据中提名药物重定位候选物，并将六个候选物推进到研究人员进行的湿实验室测试。总之，这些研究展示了反馈驱动的机器人生物实验，其框架支持关于实验流程、培养条件和生物学干预的决策。

title: Leveraging High-Activity Post-Therapeutic I-131 Scans for Deep Learning Reconstruction of Extremely Sparse Planar Images in Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
zh_title: 用治疗后高活度碘扫描重建稀疏平面图像
summary: 单中心前瞻研究纳入 111 例分化型甲状腺癌患者，测试以治疗后高活度 I-131 扫描为训练参考、经迁移学习提升诊断性稀疏平面图像质量。
key_points: 共 111 例，分训练与配对测试队列
训练五种基于 Restormer 的重建模型
采用迁移学习与输入图像叠加策略
reason: 前瞻性单中心但样本小、未报告临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Diagnostic I-131 whole-body planar imaging in differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) is count-limited by low administered activity, and quality worsens under rapid acquisition. Models trained on such data struggle because their targets lack photon statistics. Purpose: To test whether high-quality post-therapeutic (PT) I-131 scans can serve as superior training references for enhancing sparse diagnostic planar images, using transfer learning and input-image addition. Methods: In this single-center prospective study, 111 patients were enrolled in PT training (n = 19), diagnostic follow-up (FU) training (n = 58), and FU paired test (n = 34) cohorts. Five Restormer-based models were trained: FU_DLx2 on FU labels; PT_DLx2 transfer-learned on PT data; PT_DLx1+ and PT_DLx2+ with input-image addition; PT_DLx6 as a PT-only reference. Test-time processing used two-step denormalization and Poisson re-scaling to preserve noise statistics. Quality was assessed by PSNR, SSIM, and a blinded dual-reader evaluation of all 34 test-cohort patients. Results: PT_DLx2 achieved the highest PSNR (34.4 +/- 3.6 dB) and SSIM (0.81 +/- 0.07). PT_DLx1+ and PT_DLx2+ were comparable (33.8 and 33.3 dB; SSIM 0.80). FU_DLx2 ranked below the unprocessed fast scan (30.3 vs. 32.0 dB; 0.76 vs. 0.79). Subjectively, PT_DLx2+ scored highest in image quality (4.54 +/- 0.60) and diagnostic confidence (4.54 +/- 0.60), surpassing the reference standard (4.19 +/- 0.83 and 4.31 +/- 0.81; P = 0.005 and P = 0.008). FU_DLx2 and PT_DLx6 scored lowest. Conclusion: Count-rich PT scans provide effective training priors for reconstructing extremely sparse images. Input-image addition and cross-domain transfer learning from PT data outperformed direct training on count-limited diagnostic data, supporting 2x scan acceleration with quality matching or exceeding the unaccelerated standard scan for selected PT-derived configurations.
zh_abstract: 【背景】在分化型甲状腺癌（DTC）中，诊断性 I-131 全身平面显像因给药活度低而受计数限制，并且在快速采集下质量恶化。在此类数据上训练的模型表现不佳，因为其目标缺乏光子统计。【目的】检验高质量治疗后（PT）I-131 扫描是否可作为更优的训练参考，利用迁移学习和输入图像相加来增强稀疏的诊断性平面图像。【方法】在这项单中心前瞻性研究中，111 例患者被纳入 PT 训练（n = 19）、诊断随访（FU）训练（n = 58）和 FU 配对测试（n = 34）队列。训练了五个基于 Restormer 的模型：FU_DLx2 在 FU 标签上训练；PT_DLx2 在 PT 数据上进行迁移学习；PT_DLx1+ 和 PT_DLx2+ 采用输入图像相加；PT_DLx6 作为仅 PT 的参考。测试时处理使用两步去归一化和泊松重缩放以保留噪声统计。质量通过 PSNR、SSIM 以及对全部 34 例测试队列患者的盲法双读者评估进行评估。【结果】PT_DLx2 获得最高 PSNR（34.4 +/- 3.6 dB）和 SSIM（0.81 +/- 0.07）。PT_DLx1+ 和 PT_DLx2+ 相当（33.8 和 33.3 dB；SSIM 0.80）。FU_DLx2 排名低于未处理的快速扫描（30.3 对 32.0 dB；0.76 对 0.79）。主观上，PT_DLx2+ 在图像质量（4.54 +/- 0.60）和诊断信心（4.54 +/- 0.60）方面得分最高，超过参考标准（4.19 +/- 0.83 和 4.31 +/- 0.81；P = 0.005 和 P = 0.008）。FU_DLx2 和 PT_DLx6 得分最低。【结论】计数丰富的 PT 扫描为重建极度稀疏图像提供了有效的训练先验。输入图像相加和来自 PT 数据的跨域迁移学习优于在计数受限诊断数据上的直接训练，支持对选定的 PT 衍生配置实现 2 倍扫描加速，且质量匹配或超过未加速的标准扫描。

title: Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 乳腺X线视觉语言模型跨信号一致性评估
summary: 在乳腺密度与BI-RADS任务上评估四个视觉语言模型答案、置信度与解释的一致性，发现图像改变时置信度不降等问题。
key_points: 扰动问题、选项顺序与图像三类输入
图像改变后置信度未随之下降
存在推理与最终答案自相矛盾案例
reason: 评估设计有对照且揭示可靠性问题，但为两数据集预印本评估研究
abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.
zh_abstract: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）朝着直接解读医学图像的方向发展，其输出越来越多地不仅包括标签，还包括陈述的置信度和书面理由。然而，该领域仍主要仅使用准确率来评估VLM。我们在两个乳腺X线摄影数据集上，评估四个VLM在乳腺密度和BI-RADS分类中答案、置信度和解释之间的一致性。我们对问题、多项选择选项顺序和图像进行受控扰动，并评估三种输出的变化。我们的结果提示，即使乳腺X线摄影图像被改变，置信度也不会下降。打乱选项也会改变大多数VLM的答案。值得注意的是，存在模型自身陈述的推理与其最终答案相矛盾的情况，这是仅靠准确率无法捕捉的区别，但它决定了AI生成的答案是否可信。

title: Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models
zh_title: System 1 决策模型的置信度与决策可信吗？
summary: 提出开放可复现的审计基准，从校准、跨问题干扰与归因忠实度评估五款 System 1 决策模型，含合成临床分诊与提示注入任务。
key_points: 从微扰下的校准性、跨问题干扰与事后归因三个维度评估
对比 0.8B–27B 五款开放权重模型与生成式 System 2 基线
含合成临床分诊 N=900 与提示注入 N=250 等任务
reason: 新审计基准且开放，但临床部分为合成分诊数据、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: "System 1" decision models (pioneered by TypeSafe AI's Jev) replace autoregressive text generation with a single forward pass returning typed probability distributions over declared schemas (Choice, Score, Noul). While deployed for low-latency routing and automated triage, their statistical calibration and post-hoc explainability remain uncharacterized. We introduce an open, deterministic audit benchmark evaluating System 1 decision models across calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Evaluating five open-weight models (0.8B to 27B) alongside generative System 2 baselines -- both single-token logprob scoring and structured JSON/CoT decoding -- across NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage (N=900), prompt injection defense (Tensor Trust, N=250), and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite yields five findings: (1) provider confidence is an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models; normalized margin on Clef-27B) rather than empirical accuracy; (2) bundling multiple questions in one request induces directional cross-question interference (11.7% to 22.4% binary flips on Tev1-0.8B, vs. 0.1% to 0.2% on Tev1-4B); (3) System 1 models with >= 4B parameters are faster and better calibrated under syntactic shifts (ECE_w = 0.030 to 0.087) than logprob (0.144) and JSON (0.378) baselines; (4) for prompt-injection defense (N=250), >= 4B models achieve 0.988 to 0.998 AUROC with up to 95.2% recall and 0.0% false alarms at 48 to 60 ms; and (5) single-pass inference makes 512-coalition XAI interactive (1.3 to 3.2 s/input), while KernelSHAP with a logit link (S1-SHAP) mitigates softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates (89.3% to 100.0% gate recovery vs. 57.1% to 82.1% in prob space; p_adj = 0.004).
zh_abstract: “System 1”决策模型（由 TypeSafe AI 的 Jev 首创）以单次前向传播返回声明模式（Choice、Score、Noul）上的类型化概率分布，取代自回归文本生成。尽管这类模型已部署用于低延迟路由和自动分诊，其统计校准与事后可解释性仍未得到刻画。我们引入一个开放、确定性的审计基准，在保持标签的扰动下的校准、跨问题干扰以及事后归因忠实性方面评估 System 1 决策模型。我们在 NLI（e-SNLI）、对抗性句法捷径（HANS）、合成临床分诊（N=900）、提示注入防御（Tensor Trust，N=250）以及一个包含 86 个用例的逻辑门触发套件上，评估五个开放权重模型（0.8B 至 27B）以及生成式 System 2 基线——包括单 token 对数概率评分和结构化 JSON/CoT 解码——得到五项发现：(1) 提供方置信度是精确的闭式离散度变换（在低于 10B 的模型上为 1 - H(p)/ln K；在 Clef-27B 上为归一化间隔），而非经验准确率；(2) 将多个问题捆绑在一个请求中会诱发方向性跨问题干扰（Tev1-0.8B 上二元翻转率为 11.7% 至 22.4%，而 Tev1-4B 上为 0.1% 至 0.2%）；(3) 参数量 >= 4B 的 System 1 模型在句法偏移下比 logprob（0.144）和 JSON（0.378）基线更快且校准更好（ECE_w = 0.030 至 0.087）；(4) 对于提示注入防御（N=250），>= 4B 模型在 48 至 60 ms 内达到 0.988 至 0.998 AUROC，召回率高达 95.2%，虚警率为 0.0%；(5) 单遍推理使 512 个联盟的 XAI 具有交互性（1.3 至 3.2 s/输入），而带有 logit 链接的 KernelSHAP（S1-SHAP）减轻了析取 OR 门上的 softmax 饱和（门恢复率为 89.3% 至 100.0%，而概率空间中为 57.1% 至 82.1%；p_adj = 0.004）。

title: Seeing Is Not Believing: Counterfactual Lesion Erasure Teaches a Small Medical Vision-Language Agent to Report Only What the Image Shows
zh_title: 反事实病灶擦除训练小型医学视觉语言智能体
summary: 用修复擦除病灶的反事实视图构造证据敏感性差距指标，训练 MedScope-4B 使其仅在图像有病灶时报告该发现。
key_points: 无需人工标注，由分割数据生成擦除与同形对照编辑
以擦除后与对照编辑后回答率之差定义 ESG
507 例内部病例上 ESG 0.758，并与 15 个模型对比
reason: 方法设计有新意并有基线对比，但仅内部病例测试，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) often report a finding because the question names it; standard benchmarks miss this. From public segmentation datasets we build counterfactual views without manual annotation: the lesion erased by inpainting, a same-shape control edit elsewhere, and unedited lesion-free images. The evidence sensitivity gap (ESG) is the rate of absent-or-refer answers after erasure minus the rate after the control edit; it is zero for a model that ignores the image or reacts to both edits alike. MedScope-4B (Qwen3.5-4B, LoRA, image tools) was trained on label-derived trajectories, selected by a pre-registered rule and tested once against nine frontier and six open VLMs; four pre-registered checks then probed the mechanism. On 507 internal cases across five imaging types, MedScope-4B reached ESG 0.758 and claimed an erased lesion in 9.6% of cases, against 0.27-0.47 and 41-62% for the frontier models (all p<0.001), without significant loss of accuracy on real lesions. Without counterfactual views ESG fell to 0.279+-0.107 (three seeds); the effect replicated on MedGemma 1.5 4B and two unseen inpainting tools. At four external centres the advantage held but frontier models detected more real lesions; on a fresh external test MedScope-4B detected 0 of 48 pneumothorax films, with net utility below gemini-4-argon's (-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]). Matching the control edit was not shown to matter; over three seeds no fresh-external ESG advantage over removal-based DPO was established; a paired-view consistency objective did not beat a matched-compute control, while that continuation alone cut erased-lesion claims on unseen tools at every seed, at a cost in sensitivity at one. Training on erased and edited images gives a small model an evidence-gated disposition that prompting does not give frontier models; it does not improve perception, and rare critical findings need coverage.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLMs）常常因为问题中提到了某项发现而报告该项发现；标准基准测试忽略了这一点。我们从公共分割数据集构建无需人工标注的反事实视图：通过图像修复擦除病灶、在其他位置进行相同形状的对照编辑，以及未经编辑的无病灶图像。证据敏感性差距（ESG）为擦除后回答“不存在或转诊”的比例减去对照编辑后该比例；对于忽略图像或对两种编辑反应相同的模型，ESG 为零。MedScope-4B（Qwen3.5-4B、LoRA、图像工具）在由标签衍生的轨迹上训练，通过预先注册的规则选择，并仅一次对九个前沿和六个开源 VLM 进行测试；随后四项预先注册的检查探究其机制。在涵盖五种成像类型的 507 个内部病例上，MedScope-4B 达到 ESG 0.758，并在 9.6% 的病例中声称存在被擦除的病灶，而前沿模型分别为 0.27–0.47 和 41–62%（均 p<0.001），且在真实病灶上的准确率没有显著损失。在没有反事实视图的情况下，ESG 降至 0.279±0.107（三个随机种子）；该效应在 MedGemma 1.5 4B 和两种未见过的图像修复工具上得到复现。在四个外部中心，该优势得以保持，但前沿模型检测到更多真实病灶；在一项全新的外部测试中，MedScope-4B 在 48 张气胸影像中检测出 0 张，净效用低于 gemini-4-argon 的净效用（-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]）。未显示匹配对照编辑有影响；在三个随机种子上，未确立相对于基于移除的 DPO 的全新外部 ESG 优势；配对视图一致性目标未能超过匹配计算量的对照，而仅该续训在每个随机种子上都减少了在未见工具上的擦除病灶声称，在一个随机种子上以敏感性为代价。在擦除和编辑图像上训练使小模型获得一种证据门控倾向，而提示并不能使前沿模型获得这种倾向；它不改善感知，罕见关键发现需要覆盖。

title: Severity-Controlled Prediction Sets for Medication Recommendation
zh_title: 面向用药推荐的可控严重度预测集校准
summary: 提出事后校准框架CSC，按ATC层级量化失配严重度并控制用药推荐预测集。
key_points: 用ATC层级量化预测集与漏报药物的失配严重度
无需重训模型即可控制患者级平均与上分位严重度
MIMIC-IV实验显示预测集向精确或接近匹配偏移
reason: 方法有新意且用MIMIC-IV验证，但仅单库回顾实验、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Medication recommendation is a multi-label prediction task. However, existing prediction-set evaluation and calibration methods rely mainly on exact-overlap metrics and therefore treat all missed medications as equally severe, overlooking how closely the prediction set matches them within the medication hierarchy. To address this, we introduce Conformal Severity Control (CSC), a post-hoc framework for calibrating medication prediction sets under hierarchy-aware mismatch severity. CSC uses the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) hierarchy to quantify mismatch severity and controls patient-level severity without retraining the predictor, supporting both average severity and upper-quantile severity for the highest-severity mismatches. Experiments on MIMIC-IV show that CSC tracks user-specified severity tolerances and shifts prediction sets away from distant mismatches toward exact or close matches.
zh_abstract: 药物推荐是一个多标签预测任务。然而，现有的预测集评估和校准方法主要依赖精确重叠指标，因此将所有漏掉的药物视为同等严重，忽略了预测集在药物层级内与这些药物的匹配程度。为解决此问题，我们引入保形严重性控制（CSC），一种在层级感知不匹配严重性下校准药物预测集的事后框架。CSC 使用解剖治疗化学（ATC）层级来量化不匹配严重性，并在不重新训练预测器的情况下控制患者级严重性，同时支持平均严重性和针对最高严重性不匹配的上分位数严重性。在 MIMIC-IV 上的实验表明，CSC 跟踪用户指定的严重性容差，并将预测集从远距离不匹配转向精确或接近匹配。

title: Leveraging Deep Learning to Reveal Fine-Scale In Vivo Mitochondrial Dynamics and Axonal Transport.
source: PubMed · The Yale journal of biology and medicine
zh_title: 深度学习量化在体线粒体动态与轴突运输
summary: 提出深度学习半自动框架，量化果蝇在体轴突线粒体运输参数并与专家测量比对。
key_points: 基于在体轴突延时共聚焦成像
系统验证位移与速度等运输参数
评估方法复现专家测量的保真度
reason: 同行评审工具型研究，样本与验证范围有限，属增量档
abstract: [The Yale journal of biology and medicine] In axons, mitochondrial transport is essential for neuronal function and survival, and its disruption is increasingly recognized as an early pathological hallmark in multiple neurodegenerative diseases. Despite its importance, quantitative analysis of mitochondrial transport dynamics remains challenging due to complex and heterogeneous motility patterns and reliance on labor-intensive manual tracking methods. Here, we present a deep learning-assisted framework for semiautomated quantification of mitochondrial axonal transport. Using time-lapse confocal imaging of individual in vivo axons in the well-established Drosophila nervous system, we comprehensively validated transport parameters, including displacement and velocity. We further assessed the fidelity of our method in recapitulating expert-derived measurements and its potential to overcome the limitations of conventional manual tracking. Notably, our framework enables detailed characterization of dynamic behaviors during transport, including intensity-based variations and concurrent morphological changes within individual mitochondria, potentially reflecting mitochondrial physiological states that were difficult to resolve with traditional approaches. Collectively, our study establishes the feasibility of next-generation analysis for axonal transport and highlights its potential to uncover previously inaccessible aspects of mitochondrial dynamics, providing a scalable and objective framework for investigating mitochondrial in vivo transport dysfunction in neurodegenerative disease models.
zh_abstract: [The Yale journal of biology and medicine] 在轴突中，线粒体运输对神经元功能和存活至关重要，其破坏日益被认为是多种神经退行性疾病的一个早期病理标志。尽管其重要性如此，线粒体运输动态的定量分析仍然具有挑战性，原因是运动模式复杂且异质，并且依赖劳动密集的手工追踪方法。在此，我们提出一个深度学习辅助框架，用于线粒体轴突运输的半自动定量分析。利用在成熟完善的果蝇（Drosophila）神经系统中对单个在体轴突进行延时共聚焦成像，我们全面验证了运输参数，包括位移和速度。我们进一步评估了我们的方法在重现专家所得测量方面的保真度，以及其克服传统人工追踪局限性的潜力。值得注意的是，我们的框架能够详细表征运输过程中的动态行为，包括单个线粒体内基于强度的变化和同时发生的形态变化，这可能反映传统方法难以解析的线粒体生理状态。总之，我们的研究确立了轴突运输下一代分析的可行性，并强调其揭示以往难以触及的线粒体动力学方面的潜力，为研究神经退行性疾病模型中的线粒体在体运输功能障碍提供了一个可扩展且客观的框架。

title: Evidence-Grounded Iterative Reasoning for the Diagnosis of Diffuse Cystic Lung Diseases
zh_title: 证据驱动的迭代推理诊断弥漫性囊性肺疾病
summary: 提出 DCLDs-EIR 框架，将多模态大模型诊断假设与影像证据检索、疾病知识图谱验证结合。
key_points: 多视角渲染肺与囊腔分割刻画全局囊腔分布
竞争性假设引导轴位CT局部征象核查
结合临床信息检索疾病专属知识图谱
reason: 预印本新方法思路清晰，但未见外部验证与对照结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Overlapping imaging manifestations complicate the differential diagnosis of Diffuse Cystic Lung Diseases (DCLDs), while limited annotated data constrain supervised model development. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can integrate imaging and clinical information, but their diagnostic reasoning remains limited by incomplete volumetric perception and insufficient grounding in disease-specific evidence. We propose DCLDs-EIR, an evidence-grounded iterative reasoning framework coupling diagnostic hypothesis refinement with multimodal evidence acquisition and verification. Multiview renderings of predicted lung and cyst segmentations characterize global cyst distributions and initialize the differential diagnosis. Competing hypotheses guide axial CT inspection to identify local findings that, together with clinical context, inform retrieval from a disease-specific knowledge graph. Accumulated patient observations and retrieved knowledge are jointly assessed for diagnostic support and refutation to revise the diagnostic state. Updated hypotheses and unresolved distinctions guide subsequent inspection, forming a feedback loop between evidence acquisition and hypothesis verification. Multicenter evaluation demonstrates that DCLDs-EIR consistently improves diagnostic accuracy over baselines and enables traceable differential diagnosis through explicit links between diagnostic hypotheses, patient observations, and disease-specific knowledge.
zh_abstract: 弥漫性囊性肺疾病（Diffuse Cystic Lung Diseases, DCLDs）的影像学表现相互重叠，使鉴别诊断复杂化，而标注数据有限又制约了监督式模型的开发。多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）能够整合影像与临床信息，但其诊断推理仍受限于不完整的容积感知以及对疾病特异性证据的支撑不足。我们提出 DCLDs-EIR，一个以证据为基础的迭代推理框架，将诊断假设的细化与多模态证据的获取和验证相结合。对预测的肺与囊性分割进行多视角渲染，以刻画整体囊性分布并初始化鉴别诊断。相互竞争的假设引导轴位 CT 检查，以识别局部征象，这些征象与临床背景一起为从疾病特异性知识图谱中检索提供依据。累积的患者观察结果与检索到的知识被共同评估，用于提供诊断支持和进行反驳，以修正诊断状态。更新后的假设与尚未解决的鉴别点引导后续检查，形成证据获取与假设验证之间的反馈循环。多中心评估表明，DCLDs-EIR 相较基线持续提高诊断准确率，并通过诊断假设、患者观察与疾病特异性知识之间的明确关联实现可追溯的鉴别诊断。

title: Automated Reporting System for Biliopancreatic Endoscopic Ultrasound
zh_title: 胆胰超声内镜自动报告系统试验登记
summary: 山东大学齐鲁医院登记一项观察性研究，拟多中心前瞻验证420例胆胰超声内镜自动报告系统。
key_points: 系统开发与验证人群分开
前瞻多中心验证计划入组420例
主要终点为报告临床接受率差异
reason: 仅为新注册试验、尚无结果，前瞻设计是加分但信息有限
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Qilu Hospital of Shandong University; conditions: Biliopancreatic Diseases; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 420; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to develop and prospectively validate an automated reporting system to generate structured preliminary biliopancreatic EUS reports using information collected before and during EUS examinations. System development will be completed before prospective validation, and patients included in system development will be separate from those enrolled in prospective validation. The prospective multicenter validation will enroll 420 adults undergoing EUS for suspected or confirmed biliopancreatic disease. Each patient will contribute only the first eligible EUS examination. The primary endpoint is the difference in clinical acceptance rates between system-generated preliminary reports and independently prepared manual preliminary reports. Non-inferiority will be assessed using a predefined margin. A nested endosonographer-reporting substudy will also compare completion time and quality between final reports prepared by endosonographers with and without assistance of a system-generated preliminary report. The study will assess the ability of automated reporting to support accurate and efficient EUS reporting while routine clinical care remains unchanged.

abstract: [Compendium of continuing education in dentistry (Jamesburg, N.J. : 1995)] Intraoral scanning has evolved from a promising alternative to conventional impressions to a mainstream data-acquisition tool across nearly every dental field. title: Integrating evolutionary and protein language model representations for thermodynamically consistent stability prediction
zh_title: 融合进化信息与蛋白质语言模型的蛋白质热力学稳定性预测
summary: 预印本提出免训练策略EvoPhi-DDG，将热力学约束与序列表征结合，实现反转一致的蛋白质稳定性变化预测。
key_points: 基于MSAesm_ddG构建势能形式的进化条件预测器

abstract: At fixed thermodynamic conditions, protein stability changes obey reversal antisymmetry and path independence, but learned predictors need not satisfy these properties. Explicit alignment-derived evolutionary information may also complement single-sequence protein language model representations, motivating their integration under clearly defined physical constraints. Here, we develop a training-free strategy that combines thermodynamic constraints with complementary sequence representations. We first introduce EvoPhi-DDG, a potential-based adaptation of the alignment-conditioned evolutionary predictor MSAesm_ddG. By antisymmetrizing its predictions and setting the hidden biases to zero, we express stability changes as differences of a learned, evolution-informed effective potential conditioned on the mutation site and alignment context. This guarantees exact reversal consistency and exact same-site transitivity under fixed alignment contexts while preserving predictive accuracy. We further extend the adapted predictor to multiple substitutions through a background-aware construction that preserves whole-variant antisymmetry. We then combine EvoPhi-DDG with the previously published JanusDDG using fixed, equal weight averaging to test predictive complementarity without additional training. The ensemble preserves exact antisymmetry and reduces multisite pathway-closure RMSE relative to JanusDDG across all evaluated path lengths. Furthermore, the ensemble outperforms both components on S669 and S96, achieving Pearson correlations of 0.59 and 0.55, respectively, compared with 0.55 and 0.52 for JanusDDG and 0.53 and 0.48 for EvoPhi-DDG. On the multiple-substitution benchmark PTmul-NR, the ensemble achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.66, improving on JanusDDG's 0.61 and matching the EvoPhi-DDG extension at the reported precision. Together, these findings distinguish two benefits: averaging complementary predictions improves accuracy, whereas the potential-based reformulation strengthens physical consistency. They support the integration of alignment-conditioned and single-sequence representations without additional training, while separating predictive improvements from mathematical guarantees.
zh_abstract: 在固定热力学条件下，蛋白质稳定性变化遵循逆转反对称性和路径独立性，但学习型预测器未必满足这些性质。显式比对衍生的进化信息也可能补充单序列蛋白质语言模型表示，这促使在明确定义的物理约束下将它们整合。在此，我们开发了一种无需训练的策略，将热力学约束与互补序列表示相结合。我们首先引入 EvoPhi-DDG，这是对以比对为条件的进化预测器 MSAesm_ddG 的基于势能的适配。通过对其预测进行反对称化并将隐藏偏置设为零，我们将稳定性变化表示为一种学习得到的、受进化信息启发的有效势的差值，该有效势以突变位点和比对上下文为条件。这在固定比对上下文下保证精确的逆转一致性和精确的同位点传递性，同时保持预测准确性。我们进一步通过一种保留全变异体反对称性的背景感知构建，将适配后的预测器扩展到多重置换。然后，我们使用固定的等权重平均，将 EvoPhi-DDG 与先前发表的 JanusDDG 结合，以在无需额外训练的情况下检验预测互补性。该集成保持精确反对称性，并在所有评估的路径长度上相对于 JanusDDG 降低多位点路径闭合 RMSE。此外，该集成在 S669 和 S96 上优于两个组成部分，分别取得 Pearson 相关系数 0.59 和 0.55，而 JanusDDG 为 0.55 和 0.52，EvoPhi-DDG 为 0.53 和 0.48。在多重置换基准 PTmul-NR 上，该集成达到 Pearson 相关系数 0.66，优于 JanusDDG 的 0.61，并在报告精度下与 EvoPhi-DDG 扩展相匹配。总之，这些发现区分了两类收益：对互补预测取平均可提高准确性，而基于势能的重新表述增强了物理一致性。它们支持无需额外训练即可整合以比对为条件的表示和单序列表示，同时将预测改进与数学保证区分开来。

abstract: Autoregressive DNA language models generate sequences ef[fi]ciently from left to right, but many genome-analysis and sequence-editing problems are naturally conditioned on both [fl]anks. We introduce CreatiPhage, a 144.5M-parameter autoregressive DNA language model for bacteriophages, and its diffusion extension, CreatiPhage Diffusion DNA-LM (CPDD). CPDD is a 147.5M-parameter bidirectional discrete diffusion model initialized from the six-epoch CreatiPhage checkpoint. CPDD retains the pretrained Transformer, block attention residuals, and Engram conditional memory, while introducing non-causal attention, a MASK-aware base-5 Engram, centered depthwise convolution, and position-aligned nucleotide readout. Training combines masked and GIDD-style uniformly substituted bases with nucleotide- and amino-acid-level losses over a 10 kb, 32 kb, and whole-source context curriculum. On a screened panel of 522 phage CDSs, CPDD achieves higher random-mask restoration accuracy than a comparable diffusion model and performs well above codon-level references. In a mixed-corruption test, it restores 42.4% of visible incorrect bases. Frozen CPDD representations also support infA [fi]tness prediction and seven-class phage virion protein subtype classi[fi]cation. Controlled evaluations further characterize how restoration depends on visible context and identify opportunities to improve longer-range sequence recovery. Together, these results support scaffold-conditioned sequence modeling as a step towards modular design of phage genomes.
