title: Domain adaptation of a video Foundation model for Heart Failure Diagnosis from Echocardiography
zh_title: 视频基础模型领域适配诊断射血分数降低心衰
summary: 在公开心尖四腔切面视频数据上微调TimeSformer诊断HFrEF，优于仅调分类头与3D CNN基线。
key_points: 按时相切片段捕捉收缩期与舒张期动态
采用分离时空注意力与多片段推理
全量微调优于分类头微调与3D CNN
reason: 预印本可行性研究，单一公开数据集、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: The rapid advancement of foundation models has transformed computer vision, yet their adaptation to medical imaging, particularly purpose built foundation models for spatio temporal echocardiography videos, remains limited. In this work, we explore the feasibility of fine tuning a pretrained foundation model for video (TimeSformer) for automated diagnosis of reduced ejection fraction heart failure (HFrEF) from apical four chamber videos. The model is finetuned on the publicly available RVENet A4C dataset with a phase aware clip generation strategy that captures complementary systolic and diastolic dynamics. We employ divided space time attention, layer wise learning rate decay, and multi clip inference to enhance robustness under limited data. Experimental results show that full fine tuning of the proposed model outperforms classifier only tuning and a 3D CNN baseline. These findings highlight the potential of leveraging foundation video models for echocardiography based heart failure diagnosis and motivates further domain adaptation studies in medical imaging.
zh_abstract: 基础模型的快速发展已改变计算机视觉，但其在医学影像中的适配，尤其是针对时空超声心动图视频专门构建的基础模型，仍然有限。在本研究中，我们探索对预训练视频基础模型（TimeSformer）进行微调，以从心尖四腔心切面视频中自动诊断射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）的可行性。该模型在公开可用的 RVENet A4C 数据集上进行微调，采用相位感知的片段生成策略，以捕捉互补的收缩期与舒张期动态。我们采用分离时空注意力、逐层学习率衰减和多片段推理，以在数据有限的情况下增强稳健性。实验结果表明，对所提出模型进行全量微调优于仅微调分类器以及 3D CNN 基线。这些发现凸显了利用视频基础模型进行基于超声心动图的心力衰竭诊断的潜力，并推动了医学影像领域进一步的域适应研究。

title: Towards Scalable Network-Based Interventions for HIV Treatment and Prevention via R2C-Agent
zh_title: R2C-Agent：可扩展的HIV防治网络干预
summary: 针对HIV防治资源有限问题，用智能体方法在同伴推荐网络上优化干预靶向。
key_points: 接触网络难以大规模获取，同伴推荐网络为可数字化采集的替代
推荐网络与真实风险接触网络存在偏差
关注参与者仅接受一次推荐等造成的接触隐藏问题
reason: 方法学预印本，摘要未见健康结局或部署结果，属增量档
abstract: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) remains a pressing public health challenge worldwide. Targeting limited HIV prevention and treatment resources effectively with network-based algorithms is a long-standing problem with a rich history at AAMAS and other computational venues. However, optimizing targeted biomedical interventions for minimizing spread of HIV often requires observability of the contact network of HIV transmission risk behavior among individuals, which is prohibitively expensive to collect at scale. Peer referral networks, i.e., networks collected through a recursive peer referral process, are an alternative network class often used to study HIV in hidden populations that can be collected digitally at scale, but they deviate from the underlying contact network: referrals can follow non-risk social ties and participants accept only one referral, hiding contacts among already-recruited individuals. In this work, we first formalize the novel problem of planning network-based interventions to minimize HIV spread in the hidden contact network while observing only the peer referral network. Second, we implement R2C-Agent, a decision making agent for interventions that is designed around our new conditional graph diffusion model called Referral-to-Contact Diffusion (R2C-Diff). R2C-Diff positions the peer referral process as incremental corruption of the underlying contact network and learns to reverse it. R2C-Agent plans its interventions over contact networks sampled from R2C-Diff, so its decisions account for uncertainty about the hidden contact network. Finally, we conduct simulated experiments using real-world HIV network data that demonstrate that R2C-Agent empirically plans more effective interventions than baselines from interdisciplinary literature and highlight key tradeoffs and assumptions driving performance.
zh_abstract: 人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）仍然是全球紧迫的公共卫生挑战。使用基于网络的算法有效分配有限的HIV预防和治疗资源是一个长期存在的问题，在AAMAS和其他计算领域有着丰富的研究历史。然而，优化靶向生物医学干预以尽量减少HIV传播，通常需要可观测个体间HIV传播风险行为的接触网络，而在规模上收集该网络成本高得令人望而却步。同伴转介网络，即通过递归同伴转介过程收集的网络，是一种替代网络类别，常用于研究隐蔽人群中的HIV，可通过数字方式大规模收集，但它们偏离潜在的接触网络：转介可能沿非风险社会关系进行，且参与者只接受一次转介，从而隐藏了已招募个体之间的接触。在本工作中，我们首先形式化了新问题：在仅观测同伴转介网络的情况下，规划基于网络的干预以最小化隐蔽接触网络中的HIV传播。其次，我们实现了R2C-Agent，这是一种干预决策智能体，围绕我们称为Referral-to-Contact Diffusion（R2C-Diff）的新条件图扩散模型设计。R2C-Diff将同伴转介过程定位为潜在接触网络的增量破坏，并学习逆转该过程。R2C-Agent在从R2C-Diff采样的接触网络上规划其干预，因此其决策考虑了关于隐藏接触网络的不确定性。最后，我们使用真实世界HIV网络数据进行模拟实验，证明R2C-Agent在经验上规划的干预比跨学科文献中的基线更有效，并强调了驱动性能的关键权衡和假设。

title: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
zh_title: 面向青光眼检测的条件熵证据深度学习
summary: 提出以条件熵正则化的证据深度学习量化眼底图像青光眼分类不确定性，在 EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 与 RIM-ONE-DL 上与多种不确定性方法比较校准误差。
key_points: 条件熵正则的证据深度学习不确定性估计
校准误差低于深度集成、MC Dropout 等
用 Grad-CAM 聚焦指数分析可解释性
reason: 预印本方法改进，仅公共数据集验证、指标提升为主，属增量档
abstract: We propose a novel conditional entropy function as a basis for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection from retinal fundus images. Using the EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 and RIM-ONE-DL datasets for validation, we found that our proposed EDL model regularized by conditional entropy function produced uncertainty estimates with substantially lower calibration errors than Deep Ensembles, MC Dropout, post-hoc calibration and the conventional EDL framework based on Dempster uncertainty. To further probe our models' interpretability, we analyzed Grad-CAM heatmaps using a focus index representing spatial concentration. Compared with the other uncertainty quantification methods, EDL models exhibited greater separation between the index distributions of correctly and incorrectly classified fundus images. In particular, false negatives were associated with localized Grad-CAM activations that were displaced from the optic disc, consistent with its established clinical importance in glaucoma assessment. Overall, our findings suggest that our proposed EDL framework for glaucoma detection provides not only enhanced uncertainty calibration but also admits a more physiologically consistent interpretability.
zh_abstract: 我们提出一种新的条件熵函数，作为量化基于视网膜眼底图像进行青光眼检测的证据深度学习（EDL）中预测不确定性的基础。使用 EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 和 RIM-ONE-DL 数据集进行验证，我们发现，由条件熵函数正则化的所提出的 EDL 模型产生的不确定性估计，其校准误差显著低于 Deep Ensembles、MC Dropout、事后校准以及基于 Dempster 不确定性的传统 EDL 框架。为进一步探究模型的可解释性，我们使用表示空间集中度的聚焦指数分析 Grad-CAM 热图。与其他不确定性量化方法相比，EDL 模型在正确分类和错误分类眼底图像的指数分布之间表现出更大的分离度。特别是，假阴性伴随局部化的 Grad-CAM 激活，这些激活偏离视盘，这与视盘在青光眼评估中既有的临床重要性一致。总体而言，我们的发现表明，我们提出的用于青光眼检测的 EDL 框架不仅提供增强的不确定性校准，而且具有更符合生理学的一致可解释性。

title: Domain-Adversarial Adaptation from MURA to In-House Radiographs for Improved Adult Elbow Fracture Classification
zh_title: 域对抗适配迁移至院内肘部X线骨折分类
summary: 用域对抗神经网络将MURA公开数据训练模型适配至小型院内X线数据集，AUC-ROC优于仅源域与简单合并基线。
key_points: 源域MURA与目标域UofL存在域偏移
梯度反转域头学习域不变特征
DANN优于仅源域与朴素合并
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性预印本，仅报告AUC提升，属增量档
abstract: We studied domain shift in adult elbow fracture classification from radiographs when training on a large public dataset and deploying on a small, institution-specific dataset (UofL). We implemented a domain-adversarial neural network (DANN) to align feature distributions across source (MURA) and target (UofL) domains while optimizing fracture classification. A pretrained convolutional backbone was adapted to grayscale inputs; the task head predicts fracture presence, and a gradient-reversal-based domain head encourages domain-invariant features via adversarial learning. We compared four settings: (1) Source-only, (2) Target-only (limited labels), (3) Naive merge (pooled training), and (4) DANN (MURA to UofL). Evaluation on UofL test data uses AUC-ROC, and accuracy. DANN outperformed Source-only and Naive merge baselines by reducing domain bias without overfitting to the small target set. Ablations showed that progressive adversarial weight, dataset-size-aware domain loss, and domain-balanced sampling improved stability and target performance. Results demonstrated that domain alignment is a practical path to robust clinical generalization from public to local data.
zh_abstract: 我们研究了成人肘部骨折X线分类中的域偏移问题，即在大型公共数据集上训练并部署到小型、机构特定数据集（UofL）时的情况。我们实现了域对抗神经网络（DANN），以在优化骨折分类的同时对齐源域（MURA）和目标域（UofL）的特征分布。预训练卷积骨干网络被适配为灰度输入；任务头预测是否存在骨折，基于梯度反转的域头通过对抗学习鼓励域不变特征。我们比较了四种设置：（1）仅源域，（2）仅目标域（有限标签），（3）朴素合并（池化训练），（4）DANN（MURA到UofL）。在UofL测试数据上的评估使用AUC-ROC和准确率。DANN通过减少域偏差且不过拟合小型目标集，优于仅源域和朴素合并基线。消融实验表明，渐进对抗权重、数据集大小感知的域损失和域平衡采样提高了稳定性和目标域性能。结果表明，域对齐是从公共数据到本地数据实现稳健临床泛化的一条实用路径。

title: A four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: a body composition case study
zh_title: 小样本影像组学生存分析四步验证流程
summary: 提出FDR校正筛选、双路径比较、重复嵌套交叉验证与噪声负对照的四步验证流程，并在78例GEP-NET中示范。
key_points: 四步流程降低小样本影像组学过拟合
纳入高斯噪声特征负对照检验
78例GEP-NET、535个特征示范
reason: 方法学预印本，样本仅78例且无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NET) lack prognostic biomarkers, and computed tomography (CT)-based body composition radiomics at the third lumbar vertebra (L3) is a promising candidate. Small cohorts make high-dimensional radiomic models prone to overfitting and single-split evaluations variable and optimistic. This methodological study proposes a four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: (1) false discovery rate (FDR)-corrected feature selection, (2) a dual-path comparison of prior feature selection versus embedded regularization, (3) repeated nested cross-validation (CV) and (4) a negative control with Gaussian noise features. In 78 GEP-NET patients, 535 radiomic features from five L3 compartments were used to evaluate five survival models with Harrell's concordance index (C-index), time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) and integrated Brier score (IBS). Step 1 selected at least one feature in 18% of outer folds under noise (nominal level 20%) versus 84% with radiomic features. The dual-path comparison showed no consistent difference between strategies. Repeated nested CV reduced variability across seeds (41% median reduction in C-index standard deviation), but not enough to distinguish models. The nested CV C-index exceeded chance by 0.07-0.15 with radiomic features but not clearly under noise (0.40-0.42 with prior feature selection, 0.47-0.55 with embedded regularization). Frequently selected features tentatively linked greater subcutaneous fat, skeletal muscle compactness and texture to better prognosis. These findings suggest a modest prognostic signal in L3 radiomics, with considerable uncertainty that the protocol quantifies. The protocol may transfer to other small-cohort radiomic survival studies. Code: https://github.com/marielatalaveram/radiomics-survival-validation-protocol.
zh_abstract: 胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤（GEP-NET）缺乏预后生物标志物，而基于计算机断层扫描（CT）的第三腰椎（L3）身体成分放射组学是一个有前景的候选。小队列使高维放射组学模型容易过拟合，单次划分评估变异大且偏乐观。这项方法学研究提出了一种用于小队列放射组学生存分析的四步验证方案：（1）错误发现率（FDR）校正的特征选择，（2）先验特征选择与嵌入式正则化的双路径比较，（3）重复嵌套交叉验证（CV），以及（4）使用高斯噪声特征的阴性对照。在78例GEP-NET患者中，使用来自五个L3腔室的535个放射组学特征，以Harrell一致性指数（C-index）、时间依赖曲线下面积（AUC）和积分Brier评分（IBS）评估五种生存模型。第1步在噪声下（名义水平20%）于18%的外层折中至少选择一个特征，而放射组学特征为84%。双路径比较显示两种策略之间无一致差异。重复嵌套CV降低了跨种子的变异性（C-index标准差中位数降低41%），但不足以区分模型。使用放射组学特征时，嵌套CV的C-index超过随机水平0.07-0.15，但在噪声下并不明显（先验特征选择为0.40-0.42，嵌入式正则化为0.47-0.55）。频繁选择的特征初步将较多皮下脂肪、骨骼肌紧实度和纹理与更好的预后联系起来。这些发现提示L3放射组学中存在中等预后信号，同时该方案量化了相当大的不确定性。该方案可能迁移到其他小队列放射组学生存研究。代码：https://github.com/marielatalaveram/radiomics-survival-validation-protocol。

title: Odds-Structured Distributional Regression for Interpretable Time-to-Event Prediction
zh_title: ODDS-DR：可解释的分布回归生存预测
summary: 提出使输出参数在对数几率上可加的分布回归范式 ODDS-DR，用于可解释的临床事件时间预测。
key_points: 以预测时间上的概率分布替代点预测
输出参数在对数几率尺度上可加
对接临床风险建模常用概念以提升可解释性
reason: 方法学预印本，摘要未显示外部验证或大规模实证，属增量档
abstract: Time-to-event prediction is fundamentally challenged by partial observability and aleatoric uncertainty. In clinical medicine, for instance, the timing of disease progression or acute readmission is contingent on highly dynamic and largely latent health trajectories. Rather than forcing a deterministic point forecast, distributional regression offers a principled means to address this complexity by predicting a probability distribution over time. However, explaining these distributional predictions presents a key obstacle: raw distribution parameters output by the model are abstract mathematical quantities that do not align well with domain concepts. To gain interpretability, we propose a novel paradigm where output parameters are designed to be additive in log-odds---a widely established measure in clinical risk modeling. Our approach, called ODDS-DR, moves beyond technical convenience to deliver clear domain alignment as well as the layer-wise computational structure required for robust, time-dependent feature attribution. Validated across two real-world clinical cohorts, our framework matches state-of-the-art predictive performance while resolving distributional outputs into interpretable risk markers across flexible prognostic horizons.
zh_abstract: 时间到事件预测从根本上受到部分可观测性和偶然不确定性的挑战。例如，在临床医学中，疾病进展或急性再入院的时间取决于高度动态且很大程度上潜在的健康轨迹。分布回归不是强行给出确定性的点预测，而是通过预测随时间变化的概率分布，提供了一种应对这种复杂性的有原则的方法。然而，解释这些分布预测构成一个关键障碍：模型输出的原始分布参数是抽象的数学量，与领域概念并不很好对齐。为了获得可解释性，我们提出了一种新范式，其中输出参数被设计为在对数几率（log-odds）中可加——对数几率是临床风险建模中广泛确立的度量。我们的方法称为 ODDS-DR，超越了技术便利性，提供了清晰的领域对齐以及稳健的、时间依赖的特征归因所需的分层计算结构。在两个真实世界临床队列中验证后，我们的框架达到了最先进的预测性能，同时将分布输出分解为跨灵活预后时间范围的可解释风险标志物。

title: From Fluent Text to Ontology-Compatible Definitions: A Quality-Control Agentic Workflow
zh_title: 面向本体兼容定义的质量控制智能体流程
summary: 针对大模型生成的生物医学本体定义可能出现实体幻觉与逻辑冲突，提出智能体式质量控制流程以提升定义与本体约束的兼容性。
key_points: 指出现 fluent 定义不等于本体兼容
关注实体级幻觉与逻辑不一致风险
以智能体流程做生成后质量校验
reason: 应用面较窄的方法学预印本，信息量有限，属增量档
abstract: Biomedical ontologies are structured knowledge systems that must evolve continuously to represent newly emerging knowledge, but their manual maintenance remains time-consuming and laborintensive. Textual definitions are especially costly because they must be readable to humans and compatible with controlled entities, relations, and logical constraints. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising way to assist ontology engineering tasks, including definition generation. However, textual plausibility does not guarantee knowledge-system compatibility. A generated definition may be fluent and close to a reference definition, yet still fail to ground its implied entities or violate ontology-level constraints. Directly inserting such definitions into ontology libraries may therefore introduce entity-level hallucinations and logical inconsistencies. To address this problem, we propose two structured-knowledge incompatibility metrics, Entity Error Rate (EER) and Logical Inconsistency Rate (LIR), to quantify entity grounding and logical consistency for LLM-generated ontology definitions. We further develop an agentic quality-control (QC) workflow that treats definition generation as an iterative process rather than a direct decoding step: it generates definitions, extracts axioms, checks entity existence and logical consistency, and uses the resulting diagnostics to drive repair loops. Comprehensive experiments on Disease Ontology, Uberon Ontology, and Uberon-ConstraintStress demonstrate that EER and LIR complement conventional reference-based metrics by evaluating whether generated content can be grounded and checked inside the target ontology. The workflow effectively decreases EER while maintaining strong conventional text-generation performance. LIR further exposes sparse ontology-level logical failures that are invisible to text similarity metrics, although their repair remains limited.
zh_abstract: 生物医学本体是结构化知识系统，必须持续演化以表示新出现的知识，但其人工维护仍然耗时且劳动密集。文本定义尤其昂贵，因为其必须对人类可读，并与受控实体、关系和逻辑约束兼容。大语言模型（LLMs）为协助本体工程任务（包括定义生成）提供了有前景的方式。然而，文本合理性并不保证知识系统兼容性。生成的定义可能流畅且接近参考定义，但仍无法对其隐含实体进行接地，或违反本体级约束。因此，直接将此类定义插入本体库可能引入实体级幻觉和逻辑不一致。为解决此问题，我们提出两个结构化知识不兼容性指标，实体错误率（Entity Error Rate, EER）和逻辑不一致率（Logical Inconsistency Rate, LIR），以量化 LLM 生成的本体定义的实体接地和逻辑一致性。我们进一步开发了一个代理式质量控制（QC）工作流，将定义生成视为迭代过程而非直接解码步骤：它生成定义、提取公理、检查实体存在性和逻辑一致性，并利用所得诊断驱动修复循环。在 Disease Ontology、Uberon Ontology 和 Uberon-ConstraintStress 上的综合实验表明，EER 和 LIR 通过评估生成内容能否在目标本体内部接地和检查，补充了传统的基于参考的指标。该工作流有效降低 EER，同时保持较强的传统文本生成性能。LIR 进一步揭示了文本相似度指标不可见的稀疏本体级逻辑失败，尽管其修复仍然有限。

title: TrajLift: Lifting Memory Recall Trajectories with Latency-Modulated Heat Diffusion
zh_title: TrajLift：建模言语记忆提取轨迹
summary: 将言语回忆建模为层级图上的带时间轨迹，用延迟调制热扩散统一编码结构与提取时序，面向阿尔茨海默病相关分析。
key_points: 把回忆词语的顺序、迟疑与类别组织纳入计算建模

abstract: Verbal memory retrieval carries rich diagnostic information for Alzheimer's disease through the order, hesitation, and categorical organization of recalled words, yet computational modeling of this retrieval process remains largely unexplored. A key challenge is that timing and hierarchical structure are diagnostically entangled: the diagnostic meaning of retrieval timing depends on its hierarchical context. We propose TrajLift, a spectral framework that models verbal recall as timed trajectories on a hierarchical graph. Our central mechanism is latency-modulated heat diffusion on the semantic hierarchy, a unified operator that lifts each recalled word into a representation of both multi-scale hierarchical structure and continuous retrieval timing. Formal analysis shows that the resulting representation is first-order separable into structural and temporal components with spectral selectivity across hierarchical levels. On synthetic benchmarks requiring structure-time interaction, TrajLift stays near-perfect on deep hierarchies where all baselines fail. On real-world clinical data, we show that TrajLift outperforms diverse baselines by jointly modeling timing and semantic structure, with gains that grow as retrieval timing becomes more informative.
zh_abstract: 言语记忆提取通过回忆词的顺序、停顿和类别组织，为阿尔茨海默病携带丰富的诊断信息，然而对这一提取过程的计算建模在很大程度上仍未得到探索。一个关键挑战是时间与层级结构在诊断上相互纠缠：提取时间的诊断意义取决于其层级语境。我们提出 TrajLift，一个谱框架，将言语回忆建模为层级图上的带时间轨迹。我们的核心机制是语义层级上的延迟调制热扩散，这是一个统一算子，将每个被回忆词提升为同时包含多尺度层级结构和连续提取时间的表示。形式分析表明，所得表示可一阶分离为结构分量和时间分量，并具有跨层级水平的谱选择性。在需要结构—时间交互的合成基准上，TrajLift 在所有基线均失败的深层级结构上保持接近完美。在真实临床数据上，我们表明 TrajLift 通过联合建模时间和语义结构而优于多种基线，且随着提取时间变得更具信息量，增益增大。

abstract: Missing ratings can overturn a personalized model's current prediction. For completed models with additive response scores, exact worst case bounds check all missing assignments without changing the current predictor. We evaluate this audit retrospectively in two self-triage cohorts, 108 clinicians rating three simulated psychiatric interviews, and 126 counseling demonstrations annotated by ten experts. Under shared random half histories, Fisher adaptation based on observed ratings reduces log loss relative to response frequency by 0.1071 nats in the clinician audit (95% CI [0.0867,0.1261]) and 0.0223 in counseling (95% CI[0.0121,0.0321]). The counseling test excludes target experts and source videos from training. Certification covers 5.4% and 10.5% of targets; fixed width acquisition raises coverage to 13.7% and 28.6% at the same budgets. With weights and responses held fixed, the observed-rating update also has lower loss than an affine partial update while certifying exactly the same evaluated targets. The certificate establishes agreement with the completed model, not correctness or stability at intermediate updates. These rating tasks test the method; clinical usefulness remains untested.

title: Dropping Tokens Without Dropping Them: Causal Attribution for Diabetic Retinopathy

abstract: In this work, we investigate whether attention-based attribution maps in a vision transformer provide causal explanations for diabetic retinopathy (DR) classification. We introduce a principled decomposition of attention into two attribution maps: the contribution ($c_t$), which satisfies the completeness axiom in explainable artificial intelligence (xAI), and the pull ($p_t$), which quantifies causal explanations. We define an identity relating $c_t$ and $p_t$ that characterizes when $c_t$ fails to capture causality. We test whether each map is causally faithful on the MAPLES-DR dataset by dropping/inserting tokens, and report Necessity ($N$), Sufficiency ($Su$), and Faithfulness Correlation ($FC$). The pull $p_t$ achieves the highest causal alignment ($FC = 0.53$, $N = 0.71\%$, $Su = 3.0\%$), outperforming Attention Rollout, Grad-CAM, and AttnLRP. Occlusion retains better sufficiency ($Su = 1.6\%$) but is about 800 times slower. Furthermore, on MAPLES-DR, $p_t$ achieves $70\%$ of the average precision (AP) of HRDecoder, a state-of-the-art supervised lesion segmentation model, despite the absence of pixel-level supervision. Together, these findings show that the pull $p_t$ and the contribution $c_t$ form computationally efficient attribution maps for reliable causal interpretation in safety-critical medical diagnostics. The code and demo are available at https://github.com/pramath-haritz/dr-xai.
zh_abstract: 在本工作中，我们研究视觉 Transformer 中基于注意力的归因图是否为糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分类提供因果解释。我们提出一种有原则的注意力分解，将其分为两个归因图：贡献（$c_t$），它满足可解释人工智能（xAI）中的完备性公理；以及拉力（$p_t$），它量化因果解释。我们定义一个关联 $c_t$ 与 $p_t$ 的恒等式，用以刻画 $c_t$ 何时未能捕捉因果关系。我们通过在 MAPLES-DR 数据集上删除/插入 token 来检验每个图是否因果忠实，并报告必要性（$N$）、充分性（$Su$）和忠实性相关性（$FC$）。拉力 $p_t$ 取得最高的因果对齐（$FC = 0.53$，$N = 0.71\%$，$Su = 3.0\%$），优于 Attention Rollout、Grad-CAM 和 AttnLRP。遮挡法保持更好的充分性（$Su = 1.6\%$），但速度约慢 800 倍。此外，在 MAPLES-DR 上，尽管没有像素级监督，$p_t$ 达到 HRDecoder（一种最先进的监督式病灶分割模型）平均精度（AP）的 $70\%$。总之，这些发现表明，拉力 $p_t$ 与贡献 $c_t$ 构成计算高效的归因图，可用于安全关键型医学诊断中的可靠因果解释。代码和演示可在 https://github.com/pramath-haritz/dr-xai 获取。

abstract: Precise segmentation of target volumes and organs at risk is an essential prerequisite for modern, high-precision radiation therapy. However, this task has traditionally been time-consuming and subject to high interobserver variability. Motivated by these limitations, more advanced and novel approaches to automating this task have been developed over the past two decades. This narrative review highlights representative milestones, with a focus on the most recent developments. These approaches include atlas-based label propagation, convolutional architectures, promptable foundation models, and, most recently, vision-language models (VLMs), which integrate clinical text with volumetric segmentation. Each methodological generation has addressed limitations of its predecessor while introducing new ones. A substantial gap remains between research progress and clinical deployment, as routine workflows continue to be dominated by atlas-based and narrow task-specific deep-learning tools, which remain strong baselines in geometric overlap metrics but are highly rigid in terms of application, versatility, portability, and interpretability. As contouring systems further grow in complexity, conventional geometric overlap metrics become insufficient, motivating evaluation paradigms that incorporate surface-based, dosimetric, and prompt-adherence assessment. Emerging agentic architectures that combine large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and vision-language segmentation modules are leading towards more flexible, guideline-aware, interactive contouring workflows. These systems could automate flexible and interpretable knowledge-based contouring and actively support the clinical reasoning underlying target volume definition.
zh_abstract: 靶区和危及器官的精确分割是现代高精度放射治疗的必要前提。然而，该任务传统上耗时且存在较高的观察者间变异性。受这些局限性的驱动，过去二十年开发了更先进、更新颖的方法来自动化该任务。本叙述性综述强调代表性里程碑，并重点关注最新进展。这些方法包括基于图谱的标签传播、卷积架构、可提示基础模型，以及最近的视觉-语言模型（VLMs），后者将临床文本与体积分割相结合。每一代方法都解决了前一代的局限性，同时引入了新的局限性。研究进展与临床部署之间仍存在巨大差距，因为常规工作流程仍由基于图谱的工具和狭窄的任务专用深度学习工具主导；这些工具在几何重叠指标上仍是强基线，但在应用、通用性、可移植性和可解释性方面高度僵化。随着勾画系统进一步变得复杂，传统几何重叠指标变得不足，促使人们采用纳入基于表面、剂量学和提示依从性评估的评估范式。结合大语言模型、检索增强生成和视觉-语言分割模块的新兴智能体架构正引领迈向更灵活、指南感知的交互式勾画工作流程。这些系统有望自动化灵活且可解释的基于知识的勾画，并积极支持靶区定义背后的临床推理。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Marmara University; conditions: Dental Caries, Caries Risk, Dental Plaque; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 250; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to develop and evaluate an artificial intelligence (AI)-based system that can detect dental caries and dental plaque in children using intraoral digital scans and photographs, and use these findings to estimate each child's risk of developing dental caries. Children aged 4-13 years who attend Marmara University Faculty of Dentistry, Department of Pediatric Dentistry for routine dental care will be invited to participate. Participants will receive a clinical dental examination. Dental caries will be evaluated using standard clinical criteria, and dental plaque will be assessed using a plaque index. Intraoral photographs and three-dimensional digital scans of the teeth will also be obtained. Parents will complete a questionnaire about their child's toothbrushing habits, sugar consumption, fluoride use, dental visits, and selected sociodemographic factors. The collected digital images and scans will be used to train and test an AI model designed to automatically identify and measure areas of dental caries and plaque. The AI findings will then be combined with clinical examination results and oral health-related information to classify children as having low, moderate, or high caries risk. Based on the assigned caries risk level, individualized preventive recommendations such as oral hygiene instruction, dietary counseling, fluoride applications, professional plaque control, and follow-up visits will be provided. Participants will be followed according to their risk level and digital scans and clinical assessments will be repeated to evaluate changes in caries, plaque, and caries risk over time. The study is expected to provide information on whether AI-assisted digital imaging can support more objective, standardized and personalized caries risk assessment and preventive dental care in children.

abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Online medical consultation (OMC), a component of digital health, has expanded rapidly, giving rise to a variety of operational models. Furthermore, advances in artificial intelligence have created new opportunities for its evolution. With their abundant medical resources and technological capabilities, major cities such as Beijing have experienced particularly rapid growth in OMC. However, given the lack of OMC-specific regulations, the sector in Beijing still faces several legal uncertainties, notably regarding the legal status of OMC services and platform liability. Therefore, it is recommended that cities such as Beijing establish a dedicated OMC regulatory framework centered on comprehensive local departmental rules. Such rules can define the nature of services and platform liability under the overarching principle that standards should be tailored to the operational model.

abstract: In clinical datasets, data augmentation is often avoided because it can remove important unusual values, known as outliers, which are important for understanding diseases accurately. However, clinical EEG datasets often suffer from two key limitations: small sample sizes and class imbalance, which significantly reduce classification performance. To overcome these challenges, this study applies generative AI-based data augmentation techniques with a carefully designed hybrid pipeline that effectively enhances performance even on limited EEG data. Using EEG signals from 50 brain stroke patients, we investigate both traditional oversampling methods (SMOTE and ADASYN) and advanced generative models, including WGAN and WGAN-GP. Our proposed pipeline involves preprocessing EEG recordings, extracting comprehensive statistical and frequency-domain features, applying feature reduction, and evaluating multiple machine learning classifiers. Experimental results show that the combination of SelectKBest feature selection, SVM classifier, and WGAN-GP augmentation achieves the highest classification accuracy of 72%, outperforming other methods. This work introduces a novel hybrid approach for EEG-based stroke severity classification, demonstrating that generative augmentation, when integrated properly, can significantly improve performance on small clinical datasets. To the best of our knowledge, this combination of techniques has not been explored before on any dataset, providing a solid foundation for future research in automated EEG-based stroke diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 在临床数据集中，数据增强通常被避免，因为它可能移除重要的异常值（称为离群值），而这些异常值对于准确理解疾病很重要。然而，临床EEG数据集通常受两个关键限制：样本量小和类别不平衡，这会显著降低分类性能。为克服这些挑战，本研究应用基于生成式AI的数据增强技术，并采用精心设计的混合流程，即使在有限的EEG数据上也能有效提升性能。使用来自50名脑卒中患者的EEG信号，我们研究了传统过采样方法（SMOTE和ADASYN）以及先进的生成模型，包括WGAN和WGAN-GP。我们提出的流程包括预处理EEG记录、提取全面的统计和频域特征、应用特征降维，并评估多种机器学习分类器。实验结果表明，SelectKBest特征选择、SVM分类器和WGAN-GP增强的组合达到了72%的最高分类准确率，优于其他方法。本工作提出了一种新的基于EEG的卒中严重程度分类混合方法，证明生成式增强在适当集成时可显著改善小型临床数据集的性能。据我们所知，这种技术组合此前尚未在任何数据集上被探索，为基于EEG的自动化卒中诊断的未来研究提供了坚实基础。
